title: 嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
text:
要者
執事以吾土水利發策豈以澤處之士或
亦有習於經邦之務者乎而愚非其人也
然明問所及敢不攄一得之慮以効其略
焉夫吳越地鉅麗之區而浸藪之奧也自
天下輿圖按其方隅則東南下流之會相
距不千百里而灌注匯溶水半呑之蓋測
其勢高下溟渤尋丈間耳是故畛畷無數
膏腴兼倍壤異所叢鱗甲所集所謂富中
===
之甿貨殖之選他莫能尚焉則利在水也
而控清引濁潰渰淼漫混濤竝瀨滀薄沸
騰則奠居者病而播種者憂之乃其患亦
在水也然則治水之術自古蓋難之矣昔
禹八年飲至水土旣平九州已置而末年
南巡乃舉諸侯爲苗山之會夫夏邑宅中
之後未聞禹遍歷方岳也迺苗山玉帛萬
國攸同則豈事游豫爲哉毋亦云玆地水
所瀇浡而巡狩專行則以考其成觀其定
punctuated:
要者。
執事以吾土水利發策，豈以澤處之士，或亦有習於經邦之務者乎？而愚非其人也。然明問所及，敢不攄一得之慮，以効其略焉？夫吳越，地鉅麗之區，而浸藪之奧也。自天下輿圖按其方隅，則東南下流之會，相距不千百里，而灌注匯溶，水半呑之。蓋測其勢，高下溟渤尋丈間耳。是故畛畷無數，膏腴兼倍，壤異所叢，鱗甲所集，所謂富中之甿，貨殖之選，他莫能尚焉，則利在水也。而控清引濁，潰渰淼漫，混濤竝瀨，滀薄沸騰，則奠居者病，而播種者憂之，乃其患亦在水也。然則治水之術，自古蓋難之矣。昔禹八年飲至，水土旣平，九州已置，而末年南巡，乃舉諸侯爲苗山之會。夫夏邑宅中之後，未聞禹遍歷方岳也。迺苗山玉帛，萬國攸同，則豈事游豫爲哉？毋亦云玆地水所瀇浡，而巡狩專行，則以考其成，觀其定
translation_en:
…one who understands what is essential.
You gentlemen have set a policy question concerning water management in our region. Is this because you suppose that among scholars dwelling amid marshes there may be some acquainted with the business of governing the realm? I, in my ignorance, am no such person. Yet, since your discerning question touches upon this subject, how could I fail to set forth what little understanding I possess and offer an outline of my views?
Wu and Yue form a vast and splendid region, a deep repository of lakes and marshes. Examining their position on a map of the realm, we find them at the southeastern convergence of downstream waters. Within a span of less than a thousand or even a hundred li, waters pour in and collect, engulfing half the land. Measured against the sea, the elevation of the terrain differs by only a few feet. Thus field paths are innumerable, fertile soil yields abundantly, unusual products of the land abound, and fish and shellfish gather. As for what are called its prosperous inhabitants [?] and its outstanding opportunities for commerce, nowhere else can surpass it: its benefits lie in water. Yet when clear currents are drawn in together with turbid waters, embankments burst and floods spread boundlessly; waves mingle with rapids, and accumulated waters surge and seethe. Then settled inhabitants suffer, and those who sow crops are anxious. Its troubles, too, lie in water. The art of controlling water has therefore been considered difficult since antiquity.
Long ago, after eight years, Yu celebrated his return: the waters and land had been brought to order, and the Nine Provinces established. Yet in his final years he toured the south and summoned the regional lords to an assembly at Miaoshan. After the Xia capital had been established at the center of the realm, we do not hear of Yu traveling everywhere to the sacred mountains of the regions. Yet at Miaoshan, the myriad states assembled with their jade and silk offerings. Could this possibly have been an excursion for pleasure? Might it not rather have been because this region was a place where waters surged and swelled, so that he made a special inspection tour to examine the achievements and observe how securely order had been established…

title: 嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
text:
所以爲治之之術或尚不能忘情於旣平
也三代以後民生日繁而畎畝溝澮所需
益廣是故水利爲玆土一大政而百姓俯
仰之資有國征輸之計取給乎此蓋當寰
宇之半矣吾甞按之古爲吏境內者開鏡
湖於會稽復漢陂於勾章則漢馬臻晉孔
愉也捍錢塘而築之隄浚廣德而疏其隘
則唐白居易任侗也周因令奉化而濬靈
濟陳渾令餘杭而開南湖陸明允疊龍潭
===
之石李濬築陽陂之湖孟簡觀山陰而新
河北開王濟刺杭州而斗門增置諸賢相
繼卓有成績而興利障患全浙賴之卽今
感其德則廟祀遺其愛則名存或呼爲長
官之碶或稱爲資國之渠數千百年如一
日也然自三江旣入震澤底定之後凡治
吳越水者固不止數賢迺其施設大較如
是焉耳自有宋慶曆欲便糧道遂於吳江
築岸横絕江流蓋自是水流漸紆泥沙易
punctuated: 所以爲治之之術，或尚不能忘情於旣平也。三代以後，民生日繁，而畎畝溝澮所需益廣。是故水利爲玆土一大政，而百姓俯仰之資、有國征輸之計，取給乎此，蓋當寰宇之半矣。吾甞按之，古爲吏境內者，開鏡湖於會稽、復漢陂於勾章，則漢馬臻、晉孔愉也；捍錢塘而築之隄、浚廣德而疏其隘，則唐白居易、任侗也。周因令奉化而濬靈濟，陳渾令餘杭而開南湖，陸明允疊龍潭之石，李濬築陽陂之湖，孟簡觀山陰而新河北開，王濟刺杭州而斗門增置。諸賢相繼，卓有成績，而興利障患，全浙賴之。卽今感其德則廟祀，遺其愛則名存，或呼爲長官之碶，或稱爲資國之渠，數千百年如一日也。然自三江旣入、震澤底定之後，凡治吳越水者，固不止數賢，迺其施設大較如是焉耳。自有宋慶曆，欲便糧道，遂於吳江築岸，横絕江流。蓋自是水流漸紆，泥沙易
translation_en:
…as for the methods by which he brought the waters under control, perhaps he still could not put them out of his mind even after they had been pacified. After the Three Dynasties, the population steadily increased, and the need for cultivated fields and drainage channels grew ever greater. Thus water management became a major concern of government in this region. The resources on which the common people depended for their own support and that of their families, and the revenues on which the state relied, were supplied from here—amounting, indeed, to perhaps half the total for the realm.

I have examined the record of those who served as officials within this region in antiquity. Those who opened Mirror Lake at Kuaiji and restored the Han embankment at Gouzhang were Ma Zhen of the Han and Kong Yu of the Jin. Those who protected Qiantang by constructing a dike and dredged Guangde to clear its constricted waterways were Bai Juyi and Ren Tong of the Tang. Zhou Yin, as Magistrate of Fenghua, dredged Lingji; Chen Hun, as Magistrate of Yuhang, opened South Lake. Lu Mingyun piled up stones at Longtan; Li Jun constructed the lake at Yangbei. Meng Jian oversaw Shanyin, and a new canal was opened to the north [?]; Wang Ji served as Prefect of Hangzhou, and additional sluice gates were installed.

These worthy men followed one another and achieved outstanding results. All Zhejiang depended on them for the benefits they created and the disasters they prevented. Even today, gratitude for their virtue finds expression in temple sacrifices, while the enduring legacy of their benevolence preserves their names. One work is called the Magistrate’s Sluice; another is known as the Canal That Sustains the State. Through hundreds and thousands of years, this has remained unchanged.

Yet ever since the Three Rivers were led into their channels and Zhenze was brought to settled order, those who managed the waters of Wu and Yue have certainly included more than these few worthies. These examples merely give the general character of their undertakings. During the Qingli reign period of the Song, a desire to facilitate grain transport led to the construction of an embankment at Wujiang, cutting across the river’s flow. From that time onward, the water’s course gradually became more circuitous, and mud and sand readily …

title: 嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
text:
漲而東向之勢不敵渾潮是以壅積不滌
吳淞之堙無異平陸而太湖達海之道始
失其趨矣夫太湖一噎於長堤再澁於吳
淞汎溢之患理所必至况霪雨一集諸郡
奔流磕焉注之則欲其不爲廬舍稼穡之
災勢可得乎然則治水慶曆之後較之馬
臻輩殆難其功矣是故范仲淹有上宰臣
之書陳正同有言相視之札史才有圍田
之議李結有敦本之說而單鍔郏亶則其
===
經畫尤爲詳切焉自今觀之置五堰於溧
陽開百瀆於宜興置斗門於江陰建千橋
於吳江則單鍔之大槩也而環湖卑下之
地縱浦以通於江横塘以分其勢堅厚隄
岸以禦湍悍必使塘浦高於江而田無所
容水則郏亶之大槩也蓋鍔之議詳於導
水亶之見乃工於固田夫治水以爲田也
治水而不治田則濡足何益治田而不治
水則耒耜何功然則二者事誠相須而二
punctuated:
漲，而東向之勢不敵渾潮，是以壅積不滌。吳淞之堙，無異平陸，而太湖達海之道始失其趨矣。夫太湖一噎於長堤，再澁於吳淞，汎溢之患，理所必至。况霪雨一集，諸郡奔流磕焉注之，則欲其不爲廬舍稼穡之災，勢可得乎？然則治水慶曆之後，較之馬臻輩，殆難其功矣。是故范仲淹有上宰臣之書，陳正同有言相視之札，史才有圍田之議，李結有敦本之說，而單鍔、郏亶則其經畫尤爲詳切焉。
自今觀之，置五堰於溧陽，開百瀆於宜興，置斗門於江陰，建千橋於吳江，則單鍔之大槩也。而環湖卑下之地，縱浦以通於江，横塘以分其勢，堅厚隄岸以禦湍悍，必使塘浦高於江，而田無所容水，則郏亶之大槩也。蓋鍔之議詳於導水，亶之見乃工於固田。夫治水以爲田也，治水而不治田，則濡足何益？治田而不治水，則耒耜何功？然則二者事誠相須，而二
translation_en:
…accumulated, while the force of the eastward flow could not overcome the turbid tide. Thus the deposits built up without being flushed away. The Wusong became so silted up that it was no different from level ground, and Lake Tai’s passage to the sea began to lose its course. With Lake Tai first choked by the long embankment and then further obstructed at Wusong, flooding was bound to follow. Moreover, when prolonged rains gathered and torrents from the various prefectures poured into it with crashing force, how could one expect them not to devastate homes and crops? Thus, after the Qingli era, achieving success in water management was probably harder than it had been for Ma Zhen and his peers. Accordingly, Fan Zhongyan wrote a letter to the chief councilors; Chen Zhengtong submitted a memorandum discussing inspection of the terrain; Shi Cai proposed enclosed fields; and Li Jie advocated strengthening the foundation of agriculture. The plans of Shan E and Jia Dan were especially detailed and pertinent.
Viewed from the present, establishing five weirs at Liyang, opening a hundred channels at Yixing, installing sluice gates at Jiangyin, and building a thousand bridges at Wujiang constituted the broad outlines of Shan E’s proposals. As for the low-lying land surrounding the lake, longitudinal channels were to connect with the river, transverse embanked waterways were to divide the force of the flow, and strong, thick embankments were to withstand the violent currents. The embanked waterways and channels must be higher than the river, leaving no place for water to collect in the fields: these were the broad outlines of Jia Dan’s proposals. Shan E’s proposals were detailed in their treatment of channeling water, while Jia Dan’s insights were particularly skillful in securing farmland. Water is managed for the sake of cultivating fields. If water is managed but the fields are not put in order, what benefit is there in getting one’s feet wet? If the fields are put in order but water is not managed, what can plowing implements accomplish? These two undertakings indeed depend upon each other, and the two…

title: 嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
text:
子之爲議則固不可以偏廢者矣
國朝定鼎金陵之日首鑿溧水石河引之北
注而於五堰築壩以辟宣歙池陽九經之
衝則所以治其上流者何固也繼而遣大
臣夏原吉浚夏駕北貫吳塘通劉家港而
導之海周忱浚顧浦以通吳淞而導之海
此其疏浚隄防之績要不後古人之所爲
蓋諸郡農桑實
國家百費之資而經畫平成之計固不止導
===
利閭閻之間已也然邇者汎溢之患較歲
爲常今則春夏積雨爲災滋甚淪垣屋徙
蓬藿怨咨起而和氣傷目擊之憂誠切於
燃眉之急者此豈疏治之法或廢於因循
之久而便宜之政或泥於通變之權乎是
故今之爲力莫切乎決三江浚諸浦疏涇
港理岸塍禁圍占夷葑葦而凡古人已試
之迹垂成之功不可以不講矣夫三江之
梗以長橋也或者欲決去長橋以快入海
punctuated:
子之爲議，則固不可以偏廢者矣。
國朝定鼎金陵之日，首鑿溧水石河，引之北注，而於五堰築壩，以辟宣歙池陽九經之衝，則所以治其上流者何固也！繼而遣大臣夏原吉浚夏駕，北貫吳塘，通劉家港而導之海；周忱浚顧浦，以通吳淞而導之海。此其疏浚隄防之績，要不後古人之所爲。蓋諸郡農桑，實國家百費之資，而經畫平成之計，固不止導利閭閻之間已也。
然邇者汎溢之患，較歲爲常，今則春夏積雨，爲災滋甚。淪垣屋，徙蓬藿，怨咨起而和氣傷，目擊之憂，誠切於燃眉之急者。此豈疏治之法或廢於因循之久，而便宜之政或泥於通變之權乎？是故今之爲力，莫切乎決三江、浚諸浦、疏涇港、理岸塍、禁圍占、夷葑葦，而凡古人已試之迹、垂成之功，不可以不講矣。夫三江之梗，以長橋也。或者欲決去長橋，以快入海
translation_en:
…the proposals of these two masters must therefore both be retained; neither can be set aside in favor of the other.
When our dynasty established its capital at Jinling, it first excavated the Shihe at Lishui and directed its waters northward. It also built dams at Wuyan to ward off the onrush from the “nine channels” of Xuan, She, and Chiyang [?]. How firmly it thus brought the upper waters under control! Subsequently, the high minister Xia Yuanji was dispatched to dredge Xiaojia, extend the waterway north through Wutang, and connect it to Liujiagang, thereby guiding the waters to the sea. Zhou Chen dredged Gupu to connect it with the Wusong and guide the waters to the sea. These achievements in dredging and embankment construction were, in sum, no less than those of the ancients. Agriculture and sericulture in these prefectures indeed supply the state's manifold expenditures; plans to regulate the waters and bring the land into order certainly serve more than merely to bring benefits to local households.
Yet recently flooding has become a regular occurrence year after year [?], and this year prolonged spring and summer rains have made the disaster still worse. Walls and houses are submerged, and the poor are displaced from their humble dwellings. Resentful complaints arise, and the harmony of society is impaired. The distress of witnessing this is truly more pressing than the urgency of flames singeing one's eyebrows. Could it be that methods of dredging and regulation have fallen into disuse through prolonged habitual neglect, while measures suited to circumstances have become obstructed in the exercise of discretion to adapt to change? Thus, in our efforts today, nothing is more urgent than opening the Three Rivers, dredging the various pu waterways, clearing channels and creeks, repairing banks and field embankments, prohibiting enclosure and encroachment, and removing mats of aquatic growth and reeds. We must examine all the measures already tried by the ancients and the achievements they brought close to completion. Now, the obstruction of the Three Rivers is due to Changqiao, the Long Bridge. Some propose demolishing the Long Bridge to hasten the flow into the sea…

title: 嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
text:
之道則
國家之漕輓勢所必賴卽易爲木橋廣開其
𤃩以通之則衝突之憂亦終爲綱運妨焉
然則二者不可計矣若其港汊經泄之所
爲民間所侵認日漸狹小上源諸漾積受
洪流之處爲蘆埂藕蕩所屯結勢已布護
此可不厲禁以清關閉之患哉故相視開
掘宋乾道間曾詔於王炎圍田堙塞淳熈
間曾請於傅淇而岸東江尾茭蘆沙泥則
===
單鍔之憂又爲拳拳此皆可稽而行之者
彼其時所謂豪右之家肆意圍築而守倅
縣令輒爲給據今得無尚爾乎是不可不
痛滌其弊也侵圍旣去則圩隄當理彼其
時又所謂穿圩岸以便涇浜破古堤以利
漁捕而開挑減少延連隳壞今得無尚爾
乎是又不可不痛滌其弊也或曰江湖草
蕩計畝有納而圍田耕種者歲增賦焉亦
府庫之一需盡欲禁之則少損于公也夫
punctuated:
之道，則國家之漕輓，勢所必賴。卽易爲木橋，廣開其𤃩以通之，則衝突之憂，亦終爲綱運妨焉。然則二者不可計矣。若其港汊經泄之所，爲民間所侵認，日漸狹小；上源諸漾積受洪流之處，爲蘆埂藕蕩所屯結，勢已布護。此可不厲禁，以清關閉之患哉？故相視開掘，宋乾道間曾詔於王炎；圍田堙塞，淳熈間曾請於傅淇；而岸東江尾茭蘆沙泥，則單鍔之憂又爲拳拳。此皆可稽而行之者。彼其時所謂豪右之家肆意圍築，而守倅、縣令輒爲給據，今得無尚爾乎？是不可不痛滌其弊也。侵圍旣去，則圩隄當理。彼其時又所謂穿圩岸以便涇浜，破古堤以利漁捕，而開挑減少，延連隳壞，今得無尚爾乎？是又不可不痛滌其弊也。
或曰：「江湖草蕩，計畝有納，而圍田耕種者歲增賦焉，亦府庫之一需。盡欲禁之，則少損于公也。」夫
translation_en:
…the passage, yet the state's grain transport necessarily depends upon this bridge. Even if it were replaced with a wooden bridge and its openings [?] greatly widened to allow passage, the danger of collisions would still ultimately obstruct the grain convoys. Neither proposal, then, can be entertained. As for the branching channels through which water drains, private encroachment and claims of ownership have made them progressively narrower. The upstream pools that receive and hold floodwaters have become clogged with reed banks and lotus ponds, forming extensive obstructions [?]. Can strict prohibitions be neglected if the harm caused by such blockages is to be eliminated? Thus, during the Qiandao reign of the Song, an imperial command was issued to Wang Yan concerning inspection and excavation; during the Chunxi reign, a request was made to Fu Qi concerning the obstruction caused by enclosed fields. As for the reeds, sand, and mud along the banks and at the mouth of the eastern river [?], Shan E likewise expressed deeply earnest concern. These are all precedents that can be examined and acted upon. What was said at that time was that powerful families built enclosures at will, while prefects, assistant prefects, and district magistrates readily issued them documentary authorization. Could this still be happening today? These abuses must be thoroughly eradicated. Once the encroaching enclosures have been removed, the field embankments must be put in order. At that time, too, people were said to cut through field embankments to facilitate access to creeks and channels, and to breach old dikes to facilitate fishing, while dredging diminished and deterioration spread from one stretch to the next. Could this still be happening today? These abuses, too, must be thoroughly eradicated.
Someone may say: “Reed marshes in rivers and lakes yield payments assessed by the mu, and those who enclose fields for cultivation add to tax revenue each year. These receipts also supply the public treasury. To prohibit all such activities would somewhat diminish public revenue.” Now, …

title: 嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
text:
天下利害當較其重利尋尺之入而養深
長之害奚待智者辨之乎或又曰征輸疲
數民勤于力而驅之畚築則恐沈于衆也
夫逸道使民雖勞不怨即其所有之田議
之遠邇揣之厚薄而量工命日則豈厲民
于公乎至若按禹跡大勢則湖之下流莫
要吳淞今得開吳淞與黃浦會則太湖不
足瀉矣然淤澱既久工力煩浩議者又謂
黃浦吳淞其勢相敵此盛則彼必衰恐吳
淞未必通而黃浦先湮則東南之害愈急
以此則吳淞之開不易言矣然澱湖之西
曰急水曰白蜆東曰小漕曰大瀝皆東江
入海之故道今諸港淺狹而東江遂塞則
支流爲未廣至若范家浜劉家港夏駕安
亭諸處凡以達婁江導之海者則今日所
賴矣然潮汐難遏而浚治久疎則壅滯爲
可虞此可不加之意哉古之沿海三十六
浦今入海者惟茜涇七鴉白茆楊林入
punctuated: 天下利害，當較其重。利尋尺之入，而養深長之害，奚待智者辨之乎？或又曰：「征輸疲數，民勤于力，而驅之畚築，則恐沈于衆也。」夫逸道使民，雖勞不怨。即其所有之田，議之遠邇，揣之厚薄，而量工命日，則豈厲民于公乎？至若按禹跡大勢，則湖之下流莫要吳淞。今得開吳淞，與黃浦會，則太湖不足瀉矣。然淤澱既久，工力煩浩，議者又謂：「黃浦、吳淞，其勢相敵，此盛則彼必衰。恐吳淞未必通，而黃浦先湮，則東南之害愈急。」以此，則吳淞之開不易言矣。然澱湖之西，曰急水，曰白蜆；東曰小漕，曰大瀝，皆東江入海之故道。今諸港淺狹，而東江遂塞，則支流爲未廣。至若范家浜、劉家港、夏駕、安亭諸處，凡以達婁江、導之海者，則今日所賴矣。然潮汐難遏，而浚治久疎，則壅滯爲可虞，此可不加之意哉？古之沿海三十六浦，今入海者惟茜涇、七鴉、白茆、楊林，入…
translation_en:
…In weighing benefits and harms throughout the realm, one must compare their magnitude. To prize a trifling revenue while nurturing profound and lasting harm—does it take a wise man to distinguish between them? Someone else may say: “Repeated tax payments exhaust the people, who already toil hard. If they are driven to carry earth in baskets and build embankments, I fear this will weigh heavily upon the populace [?].” Yet if the people are employed in ways that will bring them ease, they will not resent even hard labor. Taking the fields they possess as the basis, assess their distance and relative productivity, then apportion the work and prescribe the days required. How would this amount to afflicting the people for public purposes?

As for examining the general configuration of the waterways associated with Yu’s works, none downstream of the lake is more important than the Wusong. If the Wusong could now be opened and joined with the Huangpu, then Lake Tai would “not suffice to drain” [?]. Yet sediment has accumulated for a long time, and the labor required would be immense. Those discussing the matter also say: “The Huangpu and Wusong rival one another in hydraulic force: when one flourishes, the other must decline. We fear that the Wusong might fail to become navigable while the Huangpu silts up first, making the danger to the southeast still more urgent.” On these grounds, opening the Wusong cannot be proposed lightly.

Yet west of Lake Dian are the waterways called Jishui and Baixian, and to its east those called Xiaocao and Dali. All are former channels by which the Dongjiang entered the sea. Today these waterways are shallow and narrow, and the Dongjiang has consequently become blocked: its branches have not been sufficiently widened. As for such places as Fanjiabang, Liujiagang, Xiajia, and Anting, all the channels that connect with the Loujiang and lead its waters to the sea are what we depend upon today. Yet the tides are difficult to restrain, and dredging and maintenance have long been neglected, so blockage is a cause for concern. Can we fail to attend to this?

Of the thirty-six coastal waterways of antiquity, those that now enter the sea are only Qianjing, Qiya, Baimao, and Yanglin; those entering…

title: 嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
text:
者惟福山許浦而已又能按其未浚者求
而導之則散流之途多而四達之勢沛矣
或曰若開諸浦東風駕海水逆注反病民
田不知百川東流有常西激有時單鍔固
已辨之而可稽也是故近理之湖則水得
所容而橫汎可銷遠濬之江則水得所趨
而雍噎可達然則所謂障患以興利或者
萬一有裨於是乎至若分瀉浙江之議則
所以殺太湖之受而省專治三江之難也
===
蓋自蕭梁大通三年吳興告災遣王奕督
率三郡大圖鑿泄而有此舉然當其時十
郡流移草竊窺伺故昭明太子有吏一呼
門動爲人蠹出丁之處必妨蠶桑之慮上
書止之夫誠以其時不可爲也而擬之今
日則民窮時詘益非可以舉嬴矣然求逸
者不吝其勞圖遠者不泥於近昔賈讓持
上策論漢庭首謂瀕河十郡治堤之費歲
且萬萬及其大決所殘無數如出數年治
punctuated:
者惟福山、許浦而已。又能按其未浚者，求而導之，則散流之途多，而四達之勢沛矣。或曰：「若開諸浦，東風駕海水逆注，反病民田。」不知百川東流有常，西激有時，單鍔固已辨之，而可稽也。是故近理之湖，則水得所容，而橫汎可銷；遠濬之江，則水得所趨，而雍噎可達。然則所謂障患以興利，或者萬一有裨於是乎？至若分瀉浙江之議，則所以殺太湖之受，而省專治三江之難也。
蓋自蕭梁大通三年，吳興告災，遣王奕督率三郡，大圖鑿泄，而有此舉。然當其時，十郡流移，草竊窺伺，故昭明太子有「吏一呼門，動爲人蠹；出丁之處，必妨蠶桑」之慮，上書止之。夫誠以其時不可爲也，而擬之今日，則民窮時詘，益非可以舉嬴矣。然求逸者不吝其勞，圖遠者不泥於近。昔賈讓持上策論漢庭，首謂瀕河十郡治堤之費，歲且萬萬；及其大決，所殘無數。如出數年治
translation_en:
…there are only Fushan and Xupu. If we can also investigate those channels that have not been dredged, locate them, and clear passages through them, there will be many routes for dispersing the flow, and water will pass freely in all directions. Some say: “If these tidal creeks are opened, easterly winds will drive seawater upstream, harming the people’s fields instead.” They do not understand that the eastward flow of the rivers is constant, whereas their being driven westward is only occasional. Shan E has already explained this distinction, and his account can be consulted. Thus, if the nearby lakes are put in order, the water will have somewhere to collect, and uncontrolled flooding can be eliminated; if the rivers farther away are dredged, the water will have somewhere to go, and obstructions can be opened. Might this perhaps contribute, however slightly, to what is called warding off harm and promoting benefit? As for the proposal to divert part of the flow into the Zhejiang River, its purpose is to reduce the water received by Lake Tai and ease the difficulty of relying entirely on work on the Three Rivers.
This undertaking originated in the third year of Datong under the Xiao Liang dynasty. When Wuxing reported a disaster, Wang Yi was dispatched to direct the three commanderies in a large-scale plan to excavate drainage channels. At that time, however, people were displaced throughout ten commanderies, and bandits were watching for opportunities. Crown Prince Zhaoming therefore feared that “whenever an official calls at a household’s gate, it readily becomes a scourge to the people; wherever adult men are conscripted, the tending of silkworms and mulberry trees will inevitably be disrupted.” He submitted a memorial to halt the work. It was indeed because the circumstances then made the undertaking impracticable. Compared with that time, the people today are impoverished and the circumstances constrained, making it still less possible to undertake additional works [?]. Yet those who seek ease do not begrudge the toil required, and those who plan for the long term do not let immediate concerns bind them. In former times, Jia Rang presented his best proposal for discussion at the Han court. He began by saying that the ten commanderies bordering the Yellow River spent as much as a hundred million annually on maintaining their embankments; when a major breach occurred, the devastation was beyond reckoning. If several years’ expenditure on maintaining…

title: 嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
text:
河之費以業所徙則河定民安千載無患
愚不能不以讓之見酌今日也蓋甞按地
勢之所歸而訊之長老之智者曰天目以
東之水可以自餘杭入德勝出沈塘遵皐
亭下臨平而瀉之江也如此則太湖所納
止孝豐安吉之流而勢減其半昔之淤浸
之田可以復膏壤之舊矣此非有待於經
濟謀猷之士乎然則毋間於浮言毋滿於
近効毋避於嫌毋遜於勢毋阻於怨毋隳
===
於勞則三吳之所賴在玆舉也已而實存
乎其人也夫上古有五官以治五材秦漢
之間天下猶有水工唐宋而下自安定分
科設敎後講治水之學於東南者復何人
哉蘇子云古者將有决塞之事必通知經
術之臣計其利害而又水工行視地勢不
得其工不可以濟也又曰三千年之間無
一人能興水利者其學亡也蓋不能無感
於時也
punctuated:
河之費，以業所徙，則河定民安，千載無患。愚不能不以讓之見酌今日也。蓋甞按地勢之所歸，而訊之長老之智者，曰：「天目以東之水，可以自餘杭入德勝，出沈塘，遵皐亭，下臨平，而瀉之江也。」如此，則太湖所納止孝豐、安吉之流，而勢減其半。昔之淤浸之田，可以復膏壤之舊矣。此非有待於經濟謀猷之士乎？然則毋間於浮言，毋滿於近効，毋避於嫌，毋遜於勢，毋阻於怨，毋隳於勞，則三吳之所賴在玆舉也已，而實存乎其人也。
夫上古有五官以治五材，秦漢之間，天下猶有水工。唐宋而下，自安定分科設敎後，講治水之學於東南者復何人哉？蘇子云：「古者將有决塞之事，必通知經術之臣計其利害，而又水工行視地勢，不得其工，不可以濟也。」又曰：「三千年之間，無一人能興水利者，其學亡也。」蓋不能無感於時也。
translation_en:
…the expenditure on river works, to provide livelihoods for those relocated, then the river would be stabilized and the people secure, with no calamity for a thousand years. In my humble view, I cannot but weigh Jia Rang’s proposals against present circumstances. I have examined the direction in which the terrain slopes and consulted knowledgeable elders, who said: “The waters east of Tianmu can be led from Yuhang into Desheng, out through Shentang, along Gaoting, down to Linping, and discharged into the river.” Thus Lake Tai would receive only the streams from Xiaofeng and Anji, and the force of the inflow would be reduced by half. Fields formerly silted up and inundated could be restored to their former fertility. Does this not await men skilled in statecraft and planning? Let them neither be swayed by idle talk nor be satisfied with immediate results; let them neither shrink from suspicion nor yield to powerful interests, neither be obstructed by resentment nor falter under toil. Then this undertaking would be the mainstay of the Three Wu region. Yet its success truly rests upon obtaining the right men.
In high antiquity there were five officials to govern the five material resources; during the Qin and Han periods, the realm still had specialists in hydraulic works. From the Tang and Song onward, after Anding established instruction divided into separate fields, who else in the southeast has taught the study of water management? Master Su said: “In antiquity, whenever channels were to be opened or breaches closed, ministers thoroughly versed in classical learning had to assess the benefits and harms, while hydraulic specialists also went out to inspect the terrain. Without obtaining such specialists, the undertaking could not succeed.” He also said: “That in three thousand years no one has been able to develop water resources is because this learning has been lost.” Surely these words expressed his concern over the circumstances of his own time.

title: 嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
text:
國家於水利董之憲臣
錫之專敕非不重其事然東南之水勢相延連
而監司所及則有分地蓋自近日事權始
分而張弛之間不無撓制其中矣夫事有
專任則功可責有定權則政乃從此非
今日之所當議者乎至於心存立功志在經
邦毅然以水利之學經術之臣任諸身而
斯民之溺日切於念則真存乎豪傑者起
而為吾東南圖之夫善於驅民者導其利
===
姑息所弗事也長於計國者治其急紛更
所弗恤也明於稽古者通其變執泥所弗
為也故曰存乎其人也而發言于庭築室
於道已耳則三吳之魚鼈未有歸壑之期
矣
punctuated: 國家於水利，董之憲臣，錫之專敕，非不重其事。然東南之水勢相延連，而監司所及則有分地。蓋自近日事權始分，而張弛之間不無撓制其中矣。夫事有專任則功可責，有定權則政乃從，此非今日之所當議者乎？至於心存立功，志在經邦，毅然以水利之學、經術之臣任諸身，而斯民之溺日切於念，則真存乎豪傑者起而為吾東南圖之。夫善於驅民者導其利，姑息所弗事也；長於計國者治其急，紛更所弗恤也；明於稽古者通其變，執泥所弗為也。故曰存乎其人也。而發言于庭，築室於道已耳，則三吳之魚鼈未有歸壑之期矣。
translation_en:
In matters of water management, the state assigns supervision to censorial officials and grants them special imperial mandates: it certainly does not treat these affairs lightly. Yet the waterways of the southeast are interconnected, while the surveillance commissioners exercise authority within separate territorial jurisdictions. Recently, authority over these affairs has begun to be divided, and interference and constraint have consequently arisen in the exercise of stricter or more lenient control. When an undertaking is entrusted to a single responsible official, results can be demanded; when authority is settled, administrative measures can be carried out. Is this not something that ought to be discussed today?

As for keeping achievement in mind and setting one’s purpose on ordering the realm, resolutely taking upon oneself the study of water management and the responsibilities of a minister versed in classical learning, and feeling ever more keenly each day the plight of these people submerged by floods—this truly depends upon outstanding men rising to devise measures for our southeast. Those skilled at directing the people guide them toward what benefits them; they do not indulge them. Those adept at planning for the state address its urgent needs; they do not shrink from disruptive changes. Those who understand how to investigate antiquity adapt its precedents to changing circumstances; they do not adhere rigidly to them. Hence I say that it depends upon finding the right men. But if all we do is voice opinions in the courtyard and build a house beside the road, taking advice from every passerby, there will be no prospect of the fish and turtles of Sanwu returning to their watercourses.

title: 嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
text:
浙江鄉試錄後序
今年秋浙江鄉試旣竣事惟
乾以次當序諸錄後序曰夫
浙爲
國家重地列諸藩首豈直山川
鉅麗物産繁茂稱雄長哉惟
乾嘗聞諸長老稽之載籍浙
===
故多魁礨瓌奇之士博大通
方之材藉以翼戴其世功烈
著當年而聲光施後世未易
更僕數也昔人推論賢者爲
品物之宗聖帝明王恒汲汲
勤求之且施及方外焉矧玆
首服多賢豪哉我
punctuated:
浙江鄉試錄後序

今年秋，浙江鄉試旣竣事，惟乾以次當序諸錄後。序曰：「夫浙爲國家重地，列諸藩首，豈直山川鉅麗、物産繁茂稱雄長哉？惟乾嘗聞諸長老，稽之載籍，浙故多魁礨瓌奇之士、博大通方之材，藉以翼戴其世，功烈著當年，而聲光施後世，未易更僕數也。昔人推論賢者爲品物之宗，聖帝明王恒汲汲勤求之，且施及方外焉，矧玆首服多賢豪哉！我
translation_en:
Postface to the Record of the Zhejiang Provincial Examination

This autumn, when the Zhejiang Provincial Examination had concluded, it fell to me, Weiqian, in due order to write a postface to its record. The postface reads:

“Zhejiang is a region of great importance to the state and ranks foremost among the provinces. Could its preeminence rest merely on the grandeur and beauty of its mountains and rivers and the abundance of its products? I, Weiqian, have heard from elders and verified in written records that Zhejiang has long produced many men of outstanding and extraordinary character, men of broad learning and comprehensive understanding. Through their service they supported and sustained the age in which they lived. Their achievements were illustrious in their own day, and their fame and glory extended to later generations. They could not readily be enumerated, even with relays of attendants. The ancients, in their assessments, held the worthy to be foremost among all beings. Sage emperors and enlightened kings constantly sought them with urgency and diligence, extending their search even beyond the realm. How much more, then, should they seek them in this foremost province, with its many worthy and outstanding men! Our …

title: 嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
text:
國家制試科甚重品式甚詳蓋
誠急之也乃今御史與諸大
夫舉行愈益虔而惟乾亦幸
濫役大方縱觀羣雋之撰即
古賢聖微眇之指當世宏達
之貫靡不爛然具矣譬諸入
寶藏之肆懸黎夜光隋珠和
===
璧紛列錯陳光英滿目即欲
盡收之其將能乎然吾聞之
白璧有考不得爲寶夏璜有
纇不得稱珍則稟稟而懼乃
相與畢精勵意竭晝夜之力
掄選之旣收其粹美者登諸
錄則又輒爲諸士欣艷無已
punctuated:
國家制試科甚重，品式甚詳，蓋誠急之也。乃今御史與諸大夫舉行愈益虔，而惟乾亦幸濫役大方，縱觀羣雋之撰，即古賢聖微眇之指、當世宏達之貫，靡不爛然具矣。譬諸入寶藏之肆，懸黎、夜光、隋珠、和璧，紛列錯陳，光英滿目，即欲盡收之，其將能乎？

然吾聞之，白璧有考，不得爲寶；夏璜有纇，不得稱珍。則稟稟而懼，乃相與畢精勵意，竭晝夜之力掄選之。旣收其粹美者登諸錄，則又輒爲諸士欣艷無已。
translation_en:
…the state attaches the greatest importance to its examination system, and its prescribed standards and procedures are most detailed, surely because it earnestly regards the search for worthy men as urgent. Now the censor and the other officials conduct the examination with ever greater reverence. I, Qian, have also had the good fortune, unworthy though I am, to serve in this distinguished region. Surveying the compositions of these many outstanding candidates, I find brilliantly embodied in them both the subtle meanings of the ancient worthies and sages and the comprehensive understanding of the broadly learned men of our own age. It is like entering a treasury where Xuanli jade, night-shining pearls, the pearl of Sui, and the jade disk of He are displayed in profusion, their brilliance filling the eyes. Even if one wished to gather them all, could one possibly do so?

Yet I have heard that a white jade disk with a flaw [?] cannot count as a treasure, nor a Xia jade pendant with a blemish be called precious. We therefore trembled with apprehension and together devoted all our concentration and resolve, exerting ourselves day and night to select the compositions. Having gathered the purest and finest and entered them in this record, I find myself endlessly rejoicing for these scholars and admiring their good fortune…

title: 嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
text:
焉夫士野棲谷汲被寬褐而
食藜藿其視尊官顯人分相
懸矣今旣錄無論異時結駟
乘軒秉鈞握斗大章顯也卽
今宴於方岳之堂與中臺貴
臣及藩臬大吏執爵獻酬而
其州閭之父老子弟皆僕僕
===
奔走服役於下其榮光溢俎
豆間矣夫諸士始進未嘗與
國家效咫尺之義而輒徼寵遇
若此夫安得不重念之哉今
鄉人爲賓客受賜於主人歡
然居之無愧色彼其心自謂
可不旋踵效爾乃若顧其囊
punctuated: 焉。夫士野棲谷汲，被寬褐而食藜藿，其視尊官顯人，分相懸矣。今旣錄，無論異時結駟乘軒，秉鈞握斗，大章顯也；卽今宴於方岳之堂，與中臺貴臣及藩臬大吏執爵獻酬，而其州閭之父老子弟皆僕僕奔走服役於下，其榮光溢俎豆間矣。夫諸士始進，未嘗與國家效咫尺之義，而輒徼寵遇若此，夫安得不重念之哉！今鄉人爲賓客，受賜於主人，歡然居之，無愧色，彼其心自謂可不旋踵效爾。乃若顧其囊
translation_en:
…indeed. These scholars dwell in the countryside and draw water from the valleys, wear loose garments of coarse cloth, and eat goosefoot and bean leaves. Compared with eminent officials and distinguished men, their station is far removed. Now that they have been selected, let us leave aside their future prospects of riding in teams of four and in dignitaries’ carriages, wielding the highest authority, and attaining great eminence. Even now they feast in the halls of the provincial authorities, exchanging ceremonial cups with high officials of the central administration and senior officials of the Provincial Administration and Surveillance Commissions. Meanwhile, the elders and younger men of their home communities hasten diligently about, serving below. Their glory overflows among the sacrificial and banquet vessels.
These scholars have only just begun their advancement and have yet to render even the slightest service to the state, yet they already receive such gracious favor. How could they fail to ponder this deeply? When a man of the community becomes a guest and receives gifts from his host, he accepts them gladly and without embarrassment because he tells himself that he can return the favor without delay. But if he looks into his purse…

title: 嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
text:
空無以復則未有不內慙而
却者也以吾闚觀諸士蓋皆
懷兼資之器挾鴻鉅之筴非
徒調吻搖筆以文辭振奇而
已吾固知慙而却免矣然自
玆以往被恩益深其於賓客
之賜籩豆之榮又奚啻萬之
===
也寧不思所自效哉人之言
曰烏號之弓谿子之弩不能
無弦而射越舲蜀艇不能無
水而浮言用未具也故夫尹
之耕野也無能利其里及起
佐商則德施乎四海仁非加
益也處便而勢利也今諸士
punctuated: 空，無以復，則未有不內慙而却者也。以吾闚觀，諸士蓋皆懷兼資之器，挾鴻鉅之筴，非徒調吻搖筆，以文辭振奇而已。吾固知慙而却免矣。然自玆以往，被恩益深，其於賓客之賜、籩豆之榮，又奚啻萬之也？寧不思所自效哉？人之言曰：「烏號之弓，谿子之弩，不能無弦而射；越舲蜀艇，不能無水而浮。」言用未具也。故夫尹之耕野也，無能利其里；及起佐商，則德施乎四海。仁非加益也，處便而勢利也。今諸士
translation_en:
…is empty, leaving him nothing with which to repay the kindness, there is no one who would not feel inward shame and draw back. From what I have observed, you gentlemen all possess manifold abilities and harbor grand plans. You do not merely ply your lips and wield your brushes to display extraordinary skill in literary composition. I am therefore certain that you will be spared such shame and withdrawal. Yet from this time onward, the favors you receive will grow ever greater. Compared with the gifts bestowed upon you as guests and the honor of the ceremonial banquet, will these not exceed them ten thousandfold? How could you fail to consider how to render service in return?

As the saying goes: “The Wuhao bow and the Xizi crossbow cannot shoot without strings; the boats of Yue and the skiffs of Shu cannot float without water.” This means that the conditions for their use are not yet complete. Thus, when Yi Yin tilled the fields, he could bring no benefit to his village; but once he arose to assist the Shang, his beneficence reached all within the Four Seas. His benevolence had not increased: his position afforded opportunity, and circumstances favored its exercise. Now you gentlemen…

title: 嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
text:
裒然充賦于有司巳釋耕而
嚮用矣况今
天子神聖壽考自堯舜周文以來
數千年間始一見焉諸士旣
幸生其時又列首藩多賢之
地豈非千載所希覯哉吾且
計諸士爭欲自效於
===
明時其心有勃勃乎不可遏者誠
無俟於人之從臾之也乃吾
猶言之不置則以一時相成
之義云爾序旣具先以質御
史御史覽而顧諸大夫曰言
可書也於是遂書之
廣東肇慶府高明縣儒學敎
punctuated:
裒然充賦于有司，巳釋耕而嚮用矣。况今天子神聖壽考，自堯舜周文以來，數千年間始一見焉。諸士旣幸生其時，又列首藩多賢之地，豈非千載所希覯哉！吾且計諸士爭欲自效於明時，其心有勃勃乎不可遏者，誠無俟於人之從臾之也。乃吾猶言之不置，則以一時相成之義云爾。序旣具，先以質御史。御史覽而顧諸大夫曰：「言可書也。」於是遂書之。

廣東肇慶府高明縣儒學敎
translation_en:
…have gathered to be presented as candidates to the responsible authorities, already leaving their ploughs behind and advancing toward service. Moreover, our present Son of Heaven is sagely, wise, and long-lived: only now, after several thousand years since Yao, Shun, and King Wen of Zhou, has such a ruler appeared again. You gentlemen are fortunate to have been born in his time and also to stand among the candidates of this foremost province, a land of many worthy men. Is this not an encounter rarely granted in a thousand years! I imagine that you gentlemen vie to offer your service in this enlightened age, your hearts surging with an irrepressible eagerness, truly needing no encouragement from others. Yet I continue to speak of it unceasingly, merely out of the obligation we share to help one another achieve fulfillment at this moment. When the preface was complete, I first submitted it to the censor for his judgment. Having read it, the censor turned to the assembled gentlemen and said, “These words deserve to be recorded.” Thus I committed them to writing.

Instructor … at the Confucian school of Gaoming County, Zhaoqing Prefecture, Guangdong …

title: 嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
text: 諭管惟乾謹序
punctuated: 諭管惟乾謹序。
translation_en: … Instructor Guan Weiqian respectfully composed this preface.

title: 嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
text:
浙江鄉試錄序
皇上御極四十年于兹歲應大比
畿省之士以貢于
朝維浙江巡按監察御史崔棟
寔祇厥載走幣數千里外聘
呈英及敎諭管惟乾爲考試
官學正李棟敎諭蘇黎庶周
===
南韓孜張廷儀楊保慶任賢
蔣自觀爲同考試官比至間
御史所徵簾以外百執事具
在一切筦鑰動中繩畫惟謹
惟毖且各籍其所司俾守之
籍旣定檄布政使司左布政
使胡堯臣右參政杜拯知提
punctuated:
浙江鄉試錄序

皇上御極四十年于兹，歲應大比，畿省之士以貢于朝。維浙江巡按監察御史崔棟，寔祇厥載，走幣數千里外，聘呈英及敎諭管惟乾爲考試官，學正李棟、敎諭蘇黎庶、周南、韓孜、張廷儀、楊保慶、任賢、蔣自觀爲同考試官。比至間，御史所徵簾以外百執事具在，一切筦鑰，動中繩畫，惟謹惟毖，且各籍其所司，俾守之。籍旣定，檄布政使司左布政使胡堯臣、右參政杜拯知提
translation_en:
Preface to the Record of the Zhejiang Provincial Examination

His Majesty has now occupied the throne for forty years. This year fell due for the triennial examination, through which scholars from the metropolitan region and the provinces were to be recommended to the court. Cui Dong, Regional Inspecting Censor for Zhejiang, respectfully discharged his duties, sending invitation gifts several thousand li to engage Chengying [?] and Guan Weiqian, a School Instructor, as Examiners. Li Dong, a School Instructor, and the School Instructors Su Lishu, Zhou Nan, Han Zi, Zhang Tingyi, Yang Baoqing, Ren Xian, and Jiang Ziguan were appointed Associate Examiners.

By the time they arrived, all the officials summoned by the censor to serve outside the examination curtain were present. Every arrangement for locks and keys conformed to the prescribed rules, with the utmost care and vigilance. Each official’s responsibilities were also entered in a register so that he would adhere to them. Once the register was settled, an official dispatch directed Hu Yaochen, Left Provincial Administration Commissioner, and Du Zheng, Right Provincial Administration Vice Commissioner, of the Provincial Administration Commission, to take charge of proctoring…

title: 嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
text:
調按察司副使王春澤僉事
陳宗虞監試事維日丙寅廼
羣提學副使范惟一所選校
諸郡縣之士四千有奇而試
之越明日丁卯恭逢我
皇上萬歲聖節御史合呈英等稽
首頓首北嚮祝曰願
===
聖天子萬壽永保民又祝曰願得
士之賢者如古俊乂以長佐
聖天子永保民無斁己巳再試壬
申三試得其中式者九十人
間次其文蓋彬彬然洋洋然
昭代之音而經世之具也幾於
道矣爰拔其尤者二十篇以
punctuated: 調，按察司副使王春澤、僉事陳宗虞監試事。維日丙寅，廼羣提學副使范惟一所選校諸郡縣之士四千有奇而試之。越明日丁卯，恭逢我皇上萬歲聖節，御史合呈英等稽首頓首，北嚮祝曰：「願聖天子萬壽，永保民！」又祝曰：「願得士之賢者，如古俊乂，以長佐聖天子永保民無斁！」己巳再試，壬申三試，得其中式者九十人。間次其文，蓋彬彬然、洋洋然，昭代之音，而經世之具也，幾於道矣。爰拔其尤者二十篇，以
translation_en:
…as Proctors, while Wang Chunze, Surveillance Vice Commissioner, and Chen Zongyu, Assistant Surveillance Commissioner, supervised the examination proceedings. On the bingyin day, more than four thousand scholars from the prefectures and counties, whom Fan Weiyi, Surveillance Vice Commissioner for Education, had selected through examination, were assembled and examined. The following day, dingmao, fell upon the sacred birthday of our Emperor, to whom we wish ten thousand years of life. The censor, together with Chengying and the others, bowed their heads to the ground and kowtowed, facing north, and prayed: “May the sage Son of Heaven live ten thousand years and protect the people forever!” They further prayed: “May we obtain worthy scholars like the outstanding men of antiquity, who will long assist the sage Son of Heaven in protecting the people forever, without weariness!”

On jisi the second session was held, and on renshen the third. Ninety candidates qualified. Their essays were then arranged in order [?]. Refined and richly expressive, they were the voice of an illustrious age and instruments for ordering the world, approaching the Way itself. Accordingly, twenty of the finest essays were selected in order to…

title: 嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
text:
獻屬呈英敘諸首簡呈英廼再
拜稽首颺言曰夫爾諸士之
獲升于斯也其亦知我
皇上所以作新之功矣乎棫樸之
詩曰周王壽考遐不作人蓋
言維文王之德之純之久久
則徵徵則動動則變而化故
===
四海九州之士因以有作而
莫不追琢其章金玉其相瑟
然濟濟以無負周之王國焉
旹楨榦而敷天下之化卽天
下之民亦皆惠鮮怙冒如萬
物之覆燾澤露於天地風雨
號稱至治故曰唐虞之際於
punctuated: 獻，屬呈英敘諸首簡。呈英廼再拜稽首，颺言曰：「夫爾諸士之獲升于斯也，其亦知我皇上所以作新之功矣乎？《棫樸》之詩曰：『周王壽考，遐不作人。』蓋言維文王之德之純之久，久則徵，徵則動，動則變而化。故四海九州之士，因以有作，而莫不追琢其章，金玉其相，瑟然濟濟，以無負周之王國焉。旹楨榦而敷天下之化，卽天下之民亦皆惠鮮怙冒，如萬物之覆燾澤露於天地風雨，號稱至治。故曰：『唐虞之際，於
translation_en: …to present them, and commissioned Chengying to write a preface at the beginning of the volume. Chengying then bowed twice, touched his forehead to the ground, and proclaimed: “You scholars who have attained advancement here—do you also understand the achievement of our August Emperor in fostering and renewing you? The poem The Oak and the Thorn (Yupu) says: ‘May the king of Zhou live long; does he not nurture men of talent?’ This speaks of the purity and enduring constancy of King Wen’s virtue. Enduring, it becomes manifest; manifest, it moves others; moving them, it changes and transforms them. Thus the scholars within the Four Seas and the Nine Provinces were inspired to rise. All refined their accomplishments as though carving and polishing, and made their substance like gold and jade. Dignified and impressive in their ranks, they did not fail the royal realm of Zhou. Then, serving as pillars of the state [?], they spread its transforming influence throughout the world. Even the common people everywhere received kindness and renewal, protection and shelter, just as all things receive the shelter and nourishing dew of Heaven and Earth, wind and rain. This was acclaimed as the highest order of government. Hence the saying: ‘In the age of Tang and Yu, at this …

title: 嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
text:
斯為盛仲尼蓋深幸竊歎之
矣寥寥數千載
聖天子迓續靈承餘四十年所治
極而徵靈貺疊應而
神武明聖羣臣震慴亦奚羨於唐
虞之理〔臣英〕嘗竊跡後先所
下
===
詔令戒敕箴儆賦詠其所為拳拳
乎正人心而易士習者總之
追琢磨切天下之士俾之乃
玉乃金精純輝瑩大者為圭
為璋次者為瑚為璉以恭事
天地百神
宗廟社稷以共保我
punctuated: 斯為盛，仲尼蓋深幸竊歎之矣。寥寥數千載，聖天子迓續靈承餘四十年所，治極而徵，靈貺疊應，而神武明聖，羣臣震慴，亦奚羨於唐虞之理？〔臣英〕嘗竊跡後先所下詔令、戒敕、箴儆、賦詠，其所為拳拳乎正人心而易士習者，總之，追琢磨切天下之士，俾之乃玉乃金，精純輝瑩，大者為圭為璋，次者為瑚為璉，以恭事天地百神、宗廟社稷，以共保我
translation_en:
…it flourished most here.” Zhongni [Confucius] surely felt profound gladness and privately sighed in admiration at this. Several thousand years have since passed. The sagely Son of Heaven has received and continued the sacred succession [?] for some forty years; his consummate governance has manifested its signs, and heavenly blessings have repeatedly responded. Divinely martial, enlightened, and sagely, he inspires awe and trembling among his ministers. What need, then, to envy the governance of Tang and Yu [Yao and Shun]?

〔Your servant Ying〕 has ventured to trace the edicts and commands, admonitions and injunctions, cautions and warnings, rhapsodies and poems issued over the years. Their earnest concern with rectifying people’s hearts and transforming scholars’ habits amounts, in sum, to carving and polishing the scholars of the realm, making them jade and gold, refined, pure, radiant, and lustrous. The greatest become gui and zhang jade tablets; those next in rank become hu and lian sacrificial vessels. Thus they may reverently serve Heaven and Earth and the hundred spirits, the imperial ancestral temples, and the altars of Soil and Grain, and together safeguard our …

title: 嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
text:
皇烈祖所遺之羣黎萬姓蓋靡一
念不斯勤焉此其勞其久視
周王百矣爾多士乃或不能
精純輝瑩瑚璉圭璋如彼中
林兔罝之士所以報周王者
則
皇上曷以寧爾多士曷以宴焉夫
===
上以圭璋瑚璉精純輝瑩相追琢
磨切而固自菲薄弗能仰副
且甘為碔若砆焉則惡乎取
夫碔之與砆雖其疎厲癍駁
不足登
宗廟明堂之用然其體質分量未
嘗敢鑿損其天人未深病也
punctuated:
皇烈祖所遺之羣黎萬姓，蓋靡一念不斯勤焉。此其勞其久，視周王百矣。爾多士乃或不能精純輝瑩，瑚璉圭璋，如彼中林兔罝之士所以報周王者，則皇上曷以寧？爾多士曷以宴焉？
夫上以圭璋瑚璉、精純輝瑩相追琢磨切，而固自菲薄，弗能仰副，且甘為碔若砆焉，則惡乎取？夫碔之與砆，雖其疎厲癍駁，不足登宗廟明堂之用，然其體質分量未嘗敢鑿損其天，人未深病也。
translation_en:
…the multitudes of common people bequeathed by our august and illustrious ancestors. Surely not a single thought is without this diligent concern. In the toil he expends and the length of time he has persisted, he surpasses the king of Zhou a hundredfold. Yet if some among you scholars cannot become refined and pure, radiant and lustrous—like hu and lian sacrificial vessels or gui and zhang jade tablets—and thus repay your sovereign as did those men setting rabbit nets in the forest in their service to the king of Zhou, how can His Majesty find peace? How can you scholars rest at ease?
His Majesty carves and polishes you, seeking to make you into jade tablets and sacrificial vessels, refined and pure, radiant and lustrous. If you persist in belittling yourselves, fail to fulfill his expectations, and are content to become mere wu or fu stones that resemble jade, what use can be made of you? Though wu and fu stones are coarse, rough, and mottled, unfit for use in the ancestral temple or the Hall of Light, their substance and measure have never presumed to injure by chiseling what Heaven gave them; people therefore do not find them deeply objectionable.

title: 嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
text:
至廼掩玉以為表而匿其繆
戾罔知懷仁義以事君甚自
湛穢次滓壤而莫之灑祓則
世且掩面疾趨惟恐其投畀
之弗逖矣今爾多士之文美
則美矣余懼殆於所稱巧笑
之瑳雜珮之儺而將貽
===
聖世風人之刺也故特重申儆焉
卷阿之什曰顒顒卬卬令聞
令望豈弟君子四方為綱如
此即爾多士信周之士而余
主司輩蓋亦洵美且華矣於
乎其勗諸於乎其尚勗諸時
總督撫巡則太子太保兵部
punctuated:
至廼掩玉以為表，而匿其繆戾，罔知懷仁義以事君，甚自湛穢次滓壤而莫之灑祓，則世且掩面疾趨，惟恐其投畀之弗逖矣。今爾多士之文，美則美矣，余懼殆於所稱「巧笑之瑳，雜珮之儺」，而將貽聖世風人之刺也。故特重申儆焉。
《卷阿》之什曰：「顒顒卬卬，令聞令望，豈弟君子，四方為綱。」如此，即爾多士信周之士，而余主司輩蓋亦洵美且華矣。於乎，其勗諸！於乎，其尚勗諸！
時總督撫巡則太子太保、兵部
translation_en:
But when one covers oneself with jade as an outward show, concealing one’s perversity, with no understanding of how to cherish benevolence and righteousness in serving the ruler, and sinks ever deeper into filth, amid dregs and dirt [?], without cleansing oneself, people will cover their faces and hurry away, fearing only that one has not been cast far enough aside. Now, you scholars’ writing is certainly beautiful. Yet I fear that it approaches what is described in the lines, “The gleam of her artful smile; the graceful sway of her assorted pendants,” and will invite a poet’s reproach in this sagely age. Thus I expressly repeat this warning.
The ode “Winding Hillside” (Juan A) says: “Dignified and lofty, of fine reputation and high standing, the gracious and joyful gentlemen serve as a guiding cord for the four quarters.” If you are like this, you scholars will truly be scholars such as those of Zhou, and we who preside over the examination may likewise be called “truly beautiful and splendid.” Ah, strive for this! Ah, may you indeed strive for this!
At this time, the official exercising supreme command and provincial supervision was the Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, of the Ministry of War …

title: 嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
text:
尚書兼右都御史胡宗憲載
揚
天子之命揆文奮武士克安其業
總理鹽法左副都御史鄢懋
卿巡鹽監察御史袁淳所至
問俗崇道右儒學者嚮風焉
乃若戶部員外郎黃乾行工
===
部主事馮符南京戶部主事
黎元中書舍人張元孝行人
鄧楚望趙格則各以使事萃
于斯咸胥嘉樂至右布政使
胡松時雖已被巡撫江西之
命矣而
璽書未至嘗與勤焉其他若參議
punctuated: 尚書兼右都御史胡宗憲，載揚天子之命，揆文奮武，士克安其業。總理鹽法左副都御史鄢懋卿、巡鹽監察御史袁淳，所至問俗，崇道右儒，學者嚮風焉。乃若戶部員外郎黃乾行、工部主事馮符、南京戶部主事黎元、中書舍人張元孝、行人鄧楚望、趙格，則各以使事萃于斯，咸胥嘉樂。至右布政使胡松，時雖已被巡撫江西之命矣，而璽書未至，嘗與勤焉。其他若參議
translation_en:
…Minister of War and concurrently Right Censor-in-Chief Hu Zongxian carried forward the Son of Heaven’s commands, directing civil affairs and invigorating military efforts, so that scholars could pursue their studies in peace. Yan Maoqing, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief charged with overall supervision of the salt administration, and Yuan Chun, Investigating Censor inspecting the salt administration, inquired into local customs wherever they went, honored the Way, and esteemed Confucian scholars. Students looked to their example.

Huang Qianxing, Vice Director in the Ministry of Revenue; Feng Fu, Secretary in the Ministry of Works; Li Yuan, Secretary in the Nanjing Ministry of Revenue; Zhang Yuanxiao, Secretariat Drafter; and Deng Chuwang and Zhao Ge, Messengers, each gathered here on official missions, and all shared in the appreciation and rejoicing. As for Hu Song, Right Provincial Administration Commissioner, although he had already been appointed Grand Coordinator of Jiangxi, the imperial letter bearing the seal had not yet arrived, and he had also contributed his efforts. Others included the Assistant Administration Commissioners…

title: 嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
text:
唐愛于錦副使劉存德凌雲
翼李燧李僑宋守志僉事歸
大道唐堯臣徐栻署都指揮
僉事鄭維清王顥均之以董
成於外而叅政谷中虛僉事
曹天祐署都指揮僉事管海
則雖先期以入
===
賀行而故事得書迺併錄其名
若氏焉
江西南昌府新建縣儒學教
諭李呈英謹序
punctuated:
唐愛、于錦，副使劉存德、凌雲翼、李燧、李僑、宋守志，僉事歸大道、唐堯臣、徐栻，署都指揮僉事鄭維清、王顥，均之以董成於外。而叅政谷中虛、僉事曹天祐、署都指揮僉事管海，則雖先期以入賀行，而故事得書，迺併錄其名若氏焉。
江西南昌府新建縣儒學教諭李呈英謹序。
translation_en:
…Tang Ai and Yu Jin, Assistant Administration Commissioners; Liu Cunde, Ling Yunyi, Li Sui, Li Qiao, and Song Shouzhi, Surveillance Vice Commissioners; Gui Dadao, Tang Yaochen, and Xu Shi, Surveillance Assistant Commissioners; and Zheng Weiqing and Wang Hao, Acting Assistant Regional Military Commissioners—all likewise supervised the successful completion of the work outside the examination compound. Although Gu Zhongxu, Administration Vice Commissioner; Cao Tianyou, Surveillance Assistant Commissioner; and Guan Hai, Acting Assistant Regional Military Commissioner, had departed beforehand to offer congratulations at court, precedent permitted their inclusion in the record. Their personal names and surnames are therefore recorded here as well.
Respectfully prefaced by Li Chengying, Instructor of the Confucian School of Xinjian County, Nanchang Prefecture, Jiangxi.

title: 嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄

punctuated:
嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試。

translation_en:
Zhejiang Provincial Examination, the fortieth year of Jiajing (1561).

Supervising Official
Cui Dong, Investigating Censor serving as Regional Inspector of Zhejiang. His courtesy name was Kongcai; he was from Jizhou, Shuntian Prefecture, and was a metropolitan graduate (jinshi) of the gengxu year.

Proctors
Hu Yaochen, Left Provincial Administration Commissioner of the Zhejiang Provincial Administration Commission. His courtesy name was Bochun; he was from Anju County, Sichuan, and was a metropolitan graduate of the wuxu year.
Du Zheng, Right Provincial Administration Vice Commissioner of the Zhejiang Provincial Administration Commission. His courtesy name was Daoji; he was from Fengcheng County, Jiangxi, and was a metropolitan graduate of the wuxu year.

Examination Supervisors
Wang Chunze, Surveillance Vice Commissioner of the Zhejiang Provincial Surveillance Commission. His courtesy name was Yirun; he was from Zhangpu County, Fujian, and was a metropolitan graduate of the dingwei year.
Chen Zongyu, Assistant Surveillance Commissioner of the Zhejiang Provincial Surveillance Commission. His courtesy name was Yushao; he was registered with the Baoning Defense Thousand-household Office in Sichuan, was originally from Yizhen County, Zhili, and was a metropolitan graduate of the gengxu year.

Examiners
Li Chengying, Instructor of the Confucian School of Xinjian County, Nanchang Prefecture, Jiangxi. His courtesy name was Zifa; he held officer-household registration in the Guilin Right Guard, Guangxi, was originally from Zhongxiang County, Huguang, and was a tribute student (gongshi) of the renzi year.
Guan Weiqian, Instructor of the Confucian School of Gaoming County, Zhaoqing Prefecture, Guangdong. His courtesy name was Tiren; he held military-household registration in the Guilin Central Guard, Guangxi, was originally from Huangmei County, Huguang, and was a tribute student of the yimao year.

Associate Examiners
Li Dong, Instructor of the Confucian School of Kaizhou, Daming Prefecture, Zhili. His courtesy name was Banglong; he was from Jishui County, Jiangxi, and was a tribute student of the renzi year.
Su Lishu, Instructor of the Confucian School of Yanjin County, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan. His courtesy name was Renbo; he was from Panyu County, Guangdong, and was a tribute student of the bingwu year.
Zhou Nan, Instructor of the Confucian School of Liling County, Changsha Prefecture, Huguang. His courtesy name was Huafu; he was from Ba County, Sichuan, and was a tribute student of the bingwu year.
Han Zi, Instructor of the Confucian School of Deping County, Dezhou, Jinan Prefecture, Shandong. His courtesy name was Mianzhi; he was from Gaochun County, Yingtian Prefecture, and was a tribute student of the renzi year.
Zhang Tingyi, Instructor of the Confucian School of Guichi County, Chizhou Prefecture, Zhili. His courtesy name was Suzhi; he was from Fuliang County, Jiangxi, and was a tribute student of the renzi year.

title: 嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
text:
第壹場
四書
君子欲訥於言而敏於行
是以聲名洋溢乎中國施及蠻貊舟車所
至人力所通天之所覆地之所載日月
所照霜露所隊凡有血氣者莫不尊親
故曰配天
乃若其情則可以爲善矣乃所謂善也
易
===
君子以教思无窮容保民无疆
觀其所聚而天地萬物之情可見矣
引而伸之觸類而長之
兼三才而兩之故易六畫而成卦分陰分
陽迭用柔剛故易六位而成章
書
元首明哉股肱良哉
四海之内咸仰朕德
皇建其有極斂時五福
punctuated:
第壹場

四書

君子欲訥於言而敏於行。

是以聲名洋溢乎中國，施及蠻貊，舟車所至，人力所通，天之所覆，地之所載，日月所照，霜露所隊，凡有血氣者，莫不尊親，故曰配天。

乃若其情，則可以爲善矣，乃所謂善也。

易

君子以教思无窮，容保民无疆。

觀其所聚，而天地萬物之情可見矣。

引而伸之，觸類而長之。

兼三才而兩之，故易六畫而成卦；分陰分陽，迭用柔剛，故易六位而成章。

書

元首明哉，股肱良哉！

四海之内，咸仰朕德。

皇建其有極，斂時五福。
translation_en:
First Session

Four Books

The gentleman wishes to be restrained in speech and diligent in action.

Thus his fame overflows throughout the central states and reaches the Man and Mo peoples. Wherever boats and carriages reach, wherever human effort penetrates, wherever heaven covers and earth supports, wherever the sun and moon shine and frost and dew fall, all who possess blood and breath honor and cherish him. Hence it is said that he is the counterpart of Heaven.

As for their innate dispositions, they are capable of becoming good. This is what is meant by goodness.

Book of Changes

The gentleman accordingly devotes inexhaustible thought to teaching and embraces and protects the people without limit.

By observing what they gather together, one can perceive the true conditions of heaven, earth, and the myriad things.

Draw it out and extend it; encounter analogous cases and develop it further.

Combine the Three Powers—heaven, earth, and humanity—and double them; thus, in the Changes, six lines form a hexagram. Distinguish yin and yang, and employ the yielding and the firm alternately; thus, in the Changes, the six positions form an ordered pattern.

Book of Documents

How discerning is the head! How worthy are the limbs—the ministers!

All within the Four Seas look up to my virtue.

The sovereign establishes the supreme standard and gathers these five blessings.

title: 嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
text:
立政任人準夫牧作三事虎賁綴衣趣馬
小尹左右攜僕百司庶府大都小伯藝
人表臣百司太史尹伯庶常吉士
詩
南有樛木葛藟縈之樂只君子福履成之
天保定爾以莫不興如山如阜如岡如陵
如川之方至以莫不增
思皇多士生此王國王國克生維周之楨
旣和且平依我磬聲
===
春秋
夏公子慶父帥師伐於餘丘〔莊公二年〕夏
季孫行父如齊〔宣公元年〕
八月公會齊侯宋公鄭伯曹伯邾人于檉
〔僖公元年〕秋齊侯宋公江人黃人會于
陽穀〔僖公三年〕
單伯至自齊〔文公十有五年〕
夏叔孫豹會晉趙武楚屈建蔡公孫歸生
衛石惡陳孔奐鄭良霄許人曹人于宋
punctuated:
立政：任人、準夫、牧，作三事；虎賁、綴衣、趣馬、小尹、左右攜僕、百司、庶府、大都、小伯、藝人、表臣、百司、太史、尹伯、庶常吉士。

詩
南有樛木，葛藟縈之。樂只君子，福履成之。
天保定爾，以莫不興。如山如阜，如岡如陵，如川之方至，以莫不增。
思皇多士，生此王國。王國克生，維周之楨。
旣和且平，依我磬聲。

春秋
夏，公子慶父帥師伐於餘丘。〔莊公二年〕夏，季孫行父如齊。〔宣公元年〕
八月，公會齊侯、宋公、鄭伯、曹伯、邾人于檉。〔僖公元年〕秋，齊侯、宋公、江人、黃人會于陽穀。〔僖公三年〕
單伯至自齊。〔文公十有五年〕
夏，叔孫豹會晉趙武、楚屈建、蔡公孫歸生、衛石惡、陳孔奐、鄭良霄、許人、曹人于宋。
translation_en:
In establishing government, the administrators, judicial officers, and governors constitute the three principal services; there are also the Tiger Guards, keepers of the robes, supervisors of horses, minor officers, attendants and servants on the left and right, the various officials, the many storehouse keepers, officers of large cities, lesser chiefs, artisans, external ministers, the various officials, the Grand Scribe, heads of offices, and the many worthy men holding regular posts.

Book of Odes
In the south are trees with drooping branches; creepers and vines entwine them. Joyful is the noble lord; blessings bring him fulfillment.
Heaven protects and secures you, so that everything flourishes. Like mountains and hills, like ridges and heights, like a river whose waters are rising, may everything increase.
Ah, the illustrious many officers, born in this royal kingdom! The royal kingdom can indeed bring forth men: they are the pillars of Zhou.
In harmony and balance, they follow the sound of our stone chimes.

Spring and Autumn Annals
In summer, Prince Qingfu led an army against Yuyuqiu. 〔Second year of Duke Zhuang.〕 In summer, Jisun Xingfu went to Qi. 〔First year of Duke Xuan.〕
In the eighth month, the Duke met the Marquis of Qi, the Duke of Song, the Earl of Zheng, the Earl of Cao, and a representative of Zhu at Cheng. 〔First year of Duke Xi.〕 In autumn, the Marquis of Qi, the Duke of Song, and representatives of Jiang and Huang met at Yanggu. 〔Third year of Duke Xi.〕
The Earl of Shan returned from Qi. 〔Fifteenth year of Duke Wen.〕
In summer, Shusun Bao met Zhao Wu of Jin, Qu Jian of Chu, Gongsun Guisheng of Cai, Shi E of Wei, Kong Huan of Chen, Liang Xiao of Zheng, and representatives of Xu and Cao at Song …

title: 嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
text:
襄公二十有七年叔孫豹會晉趙武楚
公子圍齊國弱宋向戌衛齊惡陳公子
招蔡公孫歸生鄭罕虎許人曹人于虢
昭公元年
禮記
天子祭天地祭四方祭山川祭五祀歲徧
諸侯方祀祭山川祭五祀歲徧大夫祭
五祀歲徧士祭其先
故人情者聖王之田也脩禮以耕之陳義
===
以種之講學以耨之本仁以聚之播樂
以安之
論倫無患樂之情也欣喜歡愛樂之官也
中正無邪禮之質也莊敬恭順禮之制
也若夫禮樂之施於金石越於聲音用
於宗廟社稷事乎山川鬼神則此所與
民同也
尊讓絜敬也者君子之所以相接也
第貳場
punctuated:
襄公二十有七年。叔孫豹會晉趙武、楚公子圍、齊國弱、宋向戌、衛齊惡、陳公子招、蔡公孫歸生、鄭罕虎、許人、曹人于虢。昭公元年。

禮記
天子祭天地，祭四方，祭山川，祭五祀，歲徧。諸侯方祀，祭山川，祭五祀，歲徧。大夫祭五祀，歲徧。士祭其先。
故人情者，聖王之田也。脩禮以耕之，陳義以種之，講學以耨之，本仁以聚之，播樂以安之。
論倫無患，樂之情也；欣喜歡愛，樂之官也。中正無邪，禮之質也；莊敬恭順，禮之制也。若夫禮樂之施於金石，越於聲音，用於宗廟社稷，事乎山川鬼神，則此所與民同也。
尊讓絜敬也者，君子之所以相接也。

第貳場
translation_en:
… (Twenty-seventh year of Duke Xiang.) Shusun Bao met at Guo with Zhao Wu of Jin, Prince Wei of Chu, Guo Ruo of Qi, Xiang Xu of Song, Qi E of Wei, Prince Zhao of Chen, Gongsun Guisheng of Cai, Han Hu of Zheng, and representatives of Xu and Cao. (First year of Duke Zhao.)

Book of Rites
The Son of Heaven sacrifices to Heaven and Earth, to the four directions, to the mountains and rivers, and to the deities of the five household sacrifices, completing the full round each year. The feudal lords offer sacrifices to the directions within their domains, to the mountains and rivers, and to the deities of the five household sacrifices, completing the full round each year. The great officers perform the five household sacrifices, completing the full round each year. The gentlemen sacrifice to their ancestors.
Thus human feelings are the field of the sage king. He cultivates ritual propriety to plough it, sets forth righteousness to sow it, expounds learning to weed it, takes benevolence as the foundation for gathering its harvest, and spreads music to bring it peace.
Ordered human relationships free from trouble are the essence of music; joy, delight, affection, and love are its functions. Balance and rectitude, without deviation, are the substance of ritual propriety; solemnity, reverence, deference, and compliance are its forms. As for ritual and music being expressed through bells and stone chimes, issuing forth in sounds, employed in the ancestral temples and at the altars of soil and grain, and used in serving the mountains, rivers, ghosts, and spirits—these are what the ruler shares with the people.
Respect, deference, purity, and reverence are the means by which gentlemen conduct their dealings with one another.

Second Session

title: 嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
text:
論
聖人之仁如天地
詔誥表〔內科一道〕
擬漢賜民今年田租之半詔〔文帝二年〕
擬唐以房玄齡杜如晦爲僕射誥〔貞觀三年〕

第參場
策五道
問帝王之道與天地並而其學與韋布不
同故於經綸之迹凡以垂訓當時昭鑒

論
聖人之仁如天地。

詔誥表〔內科一道〕
擬漢賜民今年田租之半詔〔文帝二年〕。
擬唐以房玄齡杜如晦爲僕射誥〔貞觀三年〕。
擬宋開天章閣引輔臣入對謝表〔慶曆三年〕。

選用軍職。
隱蔽差役。
服舍違式。
門禁鎖鑰。
盜賊捕限。

第參場
策五道。
問：帝王之道與天地並，而其學與韋布不同，故於經綸之迹，凡以垂訓當時、昭鑒
translation_en:
Discourse
The benevolence of the sage is like Heaven and Earth.

Edicts, proclamations, and memorials 〔One topic from among these [?]; the transcription is doubtful.〕
Compose an edict in the manner of the Han dynasty remitting half of the people's land tax for the current year. 〔Second year of Emperor Wen's reign.〕
Compose a proclamation in the manner of the Tang dynasty appointing Fang Xuanling and Du Ruhui as Vice Directors of the Department of State Affairs. 〔Third year of Zhenguan.〕
Compose a memorial of thanks in the manner of the Song dynasty for opening the Tianzhang Pavilion and admitting the chief ministers for an imperial audience. 〔Third year of Qingli.〕

Legal judgments 〔Five topics.〕
Selection and appointment of military officers.
Concealment to evade corvée service.
Clothing and dwellings that violate prescribed regulations.
Gate security and the custody of locks and keys.
Time limits for apprehending thieves and bandits.

Third Session
Five policy questions.
Question: The Way of emperors and kings ranks alongside Heaven and Earth, and their learning differs from that of commoners. Thus, among the recorded deeds of their governance, all that serves to transmit instruction to their own age and provide a clear mirror …

title: 嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
text:
後世者雖一言動要莫不有所紀也精
一執中之傳典謨訓誥之記唐虞三代
不可尚矣降是英君誼辟間知嚮慕若
石渠集賢崇政諸所舉動為時侈美不
知於帝王之道抑有得乎否耶洪惟我
太祖高皇帝定鼎中夏混一區宇創制立法悉
根理道今考
聖政日曆
皇明政要所載其於易書大學語孟及前代諸
===
史多所發明至於
御製文集
御註洪範
資世通訓
大明集禮之頒宏綱要旨胥不外是誠有以兼
乎古帝王而大備焉
成憲至今煥然可述迨我
皇上光昭鴻烈度越千古憲經崇典制作一新
于稽其大如
punctuated: 後世者，雖一言動，要莫不有所紀也。精一執中之傳，典謨訓誥之記，唐虞三代不可尚矣。降是，英君誼辟間知嚮慕，若石渠、集賢、崇政諸所舉動，為時侈美，不知於帝王之道抑有得乎否耶？洪惟我太祖高皇帝定鼎中夏，混一區宇，創制立法，悉根理道。今考《聖政日曆》《皇明政要》所載，其於《易》《書》《大學》《語》《孟》及前代諸史，多所發明。至於《御製文集》《御註洪範》《資世通訓》《大明集禮》之頒，宏綱要旨，胥不外是，誠有以兼乎古帝王而大備焉。成憲至今煥然可述。迨我皇上光昭鴻烈，度越千古，憲經崇典，制作一新，于稽其大如
translation_en:
…for later generations: even a single utterance or action was invariably recorded. In transmitting the teaching of refinement, single-mindedness, and holding fast to the mean, and in the records preserved in canons, counsels, instructions, and announcements, the ages of Tang Yao, Yu Shun, and the Three Dynasties cannot be surpassed. Thereafter, enlightened sovereigns and righteous rulers occasionally understood enough to aspire to their example. Undertakings at such institutions as Shiqu, Jixian, and Chongzheng were lavishly praised in their day; yet did they attain anything of the Way of emperors and kings?

We reverently reflect that our Emperor Taizu Gao established his capital in the central lands and united the realm. All the institutions he created and laws he established were rooted in principle and the Way. Examining what is recorded in the Daily Record of Sagely Government (Shengzheng rili) and Essentials of Government of the August Ming (Huang Ming zhengyao), we find many illuminating explanations of the Book of Changes, the Book of Documents, the Great Learning, the Analects, the Mencius, and the histories of earlier dynasties. As for the promulgation of the Collected Imperial Writings (Yuzhi wenji), Imperial Commentary on the Great Plan (Yuzhu Hongfan), General Instructions for Aiding the World (Zishi tongxun), and Collected Rituals of the Great Ming (Da Ming jili), their broad outlines and essential purport all remained within these same principles. Truly, his achievement encompassed those of the ancient emperors and kings and brought them to full completeness. His established institutions remain resplendent to this day and worthy of recounting.

Now our reigning emperor has gloriously illuminated these great achievements and surpassed all preceding ages. Taking the classics as his standard and venerating the canonical institutions, he has renewed the entire body of institutions and regulations. Examining the major examples, such as…

title: 嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
text:
記非聖之書以致祝多媿詞神不居歆
焉昔人又言征伐不可偃於天下乃稱
南開兩粤西闢五都者或以爲黷除兇
雪耻者晚竟貽悔此曷故也漢唐以來
上下二三千年類多可議如此洪惟我
太祖高皇帝旣定天下首嚴
郊祀之禮正神祇之號精誠對越有赫鑒觀載
在
祖訓及戒諭羣臣者何其具也其控制外夷慎
===
固邊圉貢豐則責請謚則抑大脩甲冑
徧飭城隍
詔令所宣每惓惓加慮焉豈非度越百王迥出
千古者哉
列聖相承永爲恪守迨我
皇上益覲揚而光大之
郊丘特建
享禘肅將明武周君臣之分定孔子稱師之議
古今曠典至是益備屬者外夷犯順則
punctuated: 記非聖之書，以致祝多媿詞，神不居歆焉。昔人又言，征伐不可偃於天下。乃稱南開兩粤、西闢五都者，或以爲黷；除兇雪耻者，晚竟貽悔。此曷故也？漢唐以來，上下二三千年，類多可議如此。洪惟我太祖高皇帝旣定天下，首嚴郊祀之禮，正神祇之號，精誠對越，有赫鑒觀。載在祖訓及戒諭羣臣者，何其具也！其控制外夷，慎固邊圉，貢豐則責，請謚則抑，大脩甲冑，徧飭城隍。詔令所宣，每惓惓加慮焉，豈非度越百王、迥出千古者哉！列聖相承，永爲恪守。迨我皇上，益覲揚而光大之。郊丘特建，享禘肅將，明武周君臣之分，定孔子稱師之議，古今曠典，至是益備。屬者外夷犯順，則
translation_en:
…recording books not of the sages [?], so that the invocations contained many shameful expressions, and the spirits would not accept the offerings [?]. People of old also said that punitive warfare could not be abolished throughout the realm. Yet achievements acclaimed as opening up the two Yue regions in the south and extending territory to the Five Capitals in the west were sometimes judged militaristic excesses; those who eliminated evildoers and avenged humiliation ultimately left cause for regret in their later years. Why was this? Across the two or three thousand years encompassing the Han and Tang and subsequent ages, there have been many similarly questionable matters.

We reverently reflect that, once our Emperor Taizu Gao had pacified the realm, he first made the suburban sacrifices rigorous and rectified the titles of the spirits of Heaven and Earth. With pure sincerity he faced the divine powers, whose scrutiny was manifest and resplendent. How comprehensive were the provisions recorded in the Ancestral Injunctions and in his admonitions to his ministers! In controlling foreign peoples and carefully securing the frontiers, he rebuked excessive tribute and restrained requests for posthumous titles. He extensively refurbished armor and helmets and ordered the repair of city walls and moats everywhere. In his proclamations and decrees, he repeatedly expressed earnest concern for these matters. Did he not surpass the hundred kings and stand far above the rulers of all past ages?

The successive sage emperors inherited these practices and faithfully maintained them. By the reign of our present Emperor, they have been further exalted and enlarged. A separate suburban sacrificial mound has been established, and the xiang and di ancestral sacrifices are solemnly performed. The distinction between ruler and subject in the relationship of King Wu and the Duke of Zhou has been clarified, and the deliberation over styling Confucius as Teacher has been settled. These exceptional rites, rare in past and present alike, have thus become still more complete. Recently, when foreign peoples defied the established order, then…

title: 嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
text:
議者謂不障其患則利不興然與昔人
開鏡湖復漢陂捍錢塘浚廣德濬靈濟
又有開南湖疊龍潭築陽陂導新河增
斗門漢晉而下作者接踵全浙賴焉可
指而言之歟邇檇李吳興之間行潦潢
沒大無麥禾則患屬太湖矣夫太湖東
南巨浸自禹跡後歷代疏治之者非一
人而單鍔郏亶其著也今其爲議指掌
可稽可倣而行之歟
===
國朝鑿溧水石河而于五堰築壩後復遣大
臣相繼治之昭有成績吳民頌焉非不
配禹功乃其患如故若無所爲力者何
也玆其疏滯之由果在三江耶古有三
十六浦以分其流今果一一不壅其故
耶或又謂治田治水相須爲功然耶梁
大通間欲分瀉浙江以殺其積已遣使
欲行而止不知其議尚可施之今歟而
呼門出丁之慮其在今日復何如也諸
punctuated:
議者謂不障其患則利不興。然與昔人開鏡湖、復漢陂、捍錢塘、浚廣德、濬靈濟，又有開南湖、疊龍潭、築陽陂、導新河、增斗門，漢晉而下，作者接踵，全浙賴焉，可指而言之歟？邇檇李、吳興之間，行潦潢沒，大無麥禾，則患屬太湖矣。夫太湖，東南巨浸，自禹跡後，歷代疏治之者非一人，而單鍔、郏亶其著也。今其爲議，指掌可稽，可倣而行之歟？

國朝鑿溧水石河，而于五堰築壩，後復遣大臣相繼治之，昭有成績，吳民頌焉，非不配禹功。乃其患如故，若無所爲力者，何也？玆其疏滯之由，果在三江耶？古有三十六浦以分其流，今果一一不壅其故耶？或又謂治田治水相須爲功，然耶？梁大通間，欲分瀉浙江以殺其積，已遣使，欲行而止。不知其議尚可施之今歟？而呼門出丁之慮，其在今日復何如也？諸
translation_en:
Those discussing the matter say that unless the harm is checked, the benefits cannot be realized. Yet as for the works of earlier men [?]—opening Jing Lake, restoring Han Embankment, protecting Qiantang with embankments, dredging Guangde and Lingji, as well as opening Nan Lake, building up Longtan, constructing Yang Embankment, channeling the Xin River, and adding sluice gates—from the Han and Jin onward, those undertaking such works followed one another in succession, and all Zhejiang benefited. Can you identify and discuss these works? Recently, between Zuili and Wuxing, runoff has inundated the land, causing widespread failure of wheat and rice crops; the source of the trouble thus lies with Lake Tai. Lake Tai is the great body of water of the southeast. Since Yu left his traces there, many men in successive dynasties have dredged and regulated it, among whom Shan E and Jia Dan were especially distinguished. Can their proposals now be examined as clearly as the palm of one’s hand, and can they be followed and put into practice?

Our dynasty cut the Shihe channel at Lishui and built dams at Wuyan. Later it repeatedly dispatched high officials to continue the work. Their achievements were manifest, and the people of Wu praised them; their accomplishments were indeed worthy of comparison with Yu’s. Why, then, does the trouble persist as before, as though no effort had been made? Does the cause of this impeded drainage really lie in the Three Rivers? In antiquity there were thirty-six outlets to divide the flow. Is every one of their former channels truly unobstructed today? Some further say that managing farmland and managing water depend upon one another for success. Is this so? During the Datong era of the Liang dynasty, there was a proposal to divert the waters of the Zhe River to reduce their accumulation. An envoy had already been dispatched, but the undertaking was halted just as it was about to proceed. Could that proposal still be implemented today? And what of the concern about calling at households to levy adult men [?]—how does that apply today? You gentlemen …

title: 嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
text:
第壹塲
四書
君子欲訥於言而敏於行
鄭秉厚
同考試官敎諭韓批訥言敏行是君子用心
體道處此作得之宜錄以式
同考試官敎諭蘇批發揮君子欲字意最爲
真切必嘗致力於言行者取之
考試官敎諭管批典雅
===
考試官敎諭李批認理之作
聖人論君子之用心慎言勵行而已矣夫言易
而行難也君子慎其易者而勵於其難焉敦行
之心何如哉夫子欲學者之審所尚也故爲之
言曰天下之道以言而顯以行而成言與行均
之君子之不可巳也然放言則易而恒失之有
餘力行實難而每病於不足君子之用其心固
深辨乎此矣是故慮口說之易窮而慎密中涵
惟欲藏默以斂其華思大言之可怍而靜專內
punctuated:
第壹塲
四書
「君子欲訥於言而敏於行。」
鄭秉厚

同考試官敎諭韓批：「訥言敏行，是君子用心體道處。此作得之，宜錄以式。」
同考試官敎諭蘇批：「發揮君子欲字意，最爲真切，必嘗致力於言行者，取之。」
考試官敎諭管批：「典雅。」
考試官敎諭李批：「認理之作。」

聖人論君子之用心，慎言勵行而已矣。夫言易而行難也，君子慎其易者而勵於其難焉，敦行之心何如哉！夫子欲學者之審所尚也，故爲之言曰：「天下之道，以言而顯，以行而成。言與行，均之君子之不可巳也。然放言則易，而恒失之有餘；力行實難，而每病於不足。君子之用其心，固深辨乎此矣。是故慮口說之易窮，而慎密中涵，惟欲藏默以斂其華；思大言之可怍，而靜專內
translation_en:
First Session
Four Books
“The gentleman desires to be slow in speech and prompt in action.”
Zheng Binghou

Comment by Associate Examiner Han, Instructor: “Being slow in speech and prompt in action is where the gentleman directs his mind toward embodying the Way. This composition grasps that point and should be recorded as a model.”
Comment by Associate Examiner Su, Instructor: “The exposition of the meaning of ‘desires’ in the statement about the gentleman is especially true and precise. The author must have devoted effort to his own speech and conduct. Select it.”
Comment by Examiner Guan, Instructor: “Refined and elegant.”
Comment by Examiner Li, Instructor: “A composition that apprehends principle.”

When the Sage discusses how the gentleman directs his mind, it amounts simply to caution in speech and diligence in action. Speaking is easy, whereas acting is difficult. The gentleman exercises caution in what is easy and exerts himself in what is difficult. How earnest is his resolve to act! The Master wished students to examine carefully what they esteemed, and therefore spoke to them thus: “The Way throughout the world is made manifest through speech and brought to fulfillment through action. Speech and action are equally indispensable to the gentleman. Yet unrestrained speech is easy and constantly errs on the side of excess; vigorous action is truly difficult and repeatedly suffers from insufficiency. In directing his mind, the gentleman has certainly discerned this distinction profoundly. Thus, concerned that spoken assertions may easily leave him at a loss, he nurtures caution and reserve within, desiring only to remain silent and conceal himself so as to restrain outward brilliance. Reflecting that grand pronouncements may bring shame, he is inwardly still and focused …

title: 嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
text:
特惟欲含章以貞其守時未可言固隱焉而不
發矣雖言適其時亦將慎以出之而起羞之患
未嘗不誠之于思也理不當言固謹焉而不放
矣雖言幾于理亦將訒以居之而尚口之戒未
嘗不研之于慮也此于人之易至有餘者君子
有以矯其常矣至於行則所以履乎其事者也
而非可以怠心乗之也必自强於養辭之餘而
允蹈之勤期日新以脩其業致健於先行之際
而進爲之勇務時敏以成乎身道之所在則思
===
遵之不已也而亹亹不倦不敢一息之少懈蓋
凡吾性之所固有者默而成之惟以力之不足
爲憂矣義之所在則思見之必爲也而孳孳不
已不敢一念之或弛蓋凡吾分之所當爲者推
而極之惟以躬之不逮爲耻矣是君子非盡廢
乎言也而欲訥者其心也以訥爲言不爲君子
之善言矣乎非取必於行也而欲敏者其心也
以敏爲行不爲君子之善行矣乎言行善而君
子之心學盡乎此矣夫人顧忽其易而不勉其
punctuated: 特，惟欲含章以貞其守。時未可言，固隱焉而不發矣；雖言適其時，亦將慎以出之，而起羞之患，未嘗不誠之于思也。理不當言，固謹焉而不放矣；雖言幾于理，亦將訒以居之，而尚口之戒，未嘗不研之于慮也。此于人之易至有餘者，君子有以矯其常矣。至於行，則所以履乎其事者也，而非可以怠心乗之也。必自强於養辭之餘，而允蹈之勤，期日新以脩其業；致健於先行之際，而進爲之勇，務時敏以成乎身。道之所在，則思遵之不已也，而亹亹不倦，不敢一息之少懈。蓋凡吾性之所固有者，默而成之，惟以力之不足爲憂矣。義之所在，則思見之必爲也，而孳孳不已，不敢一念之或弛。蓋凡吾分之所當爲者，推而極之，惟以躬之不逮爲耻矣。是君子非盡廢乎言也，而欲訥者其心也。以訥爲言，不爲君子之善言矣乎？非取必於行也，而欲敏者其心也。以敏爲行，不爲君子之善行矣乎？言行善，而君子之心學盡乎此矣。夫人顧忽其易，而不勉其
translation_en: …holding firm inwardly [?], wishing only to keep his excellence concealed and remain steadfast in what he upholds. When the time is not right to speak, he certainly keeps his thoughts hidden and does not express them. Even when speech is timely, he will utter it cautiously, never failing to consider earnestly the danger of bringing shame upon himself. When principle does not warrant speaking, he certainly exercises restraint and does not speak freely. Even when his words approach conformity with principle, he will remain hesitant to speak, never failing to ponder deeply the admonition against prizing eloquence. Thus, in something in which people readily go to excess, the gentleman has a means of correcting their habitual tendency. As for action, it is the means of putting affairs into practice and cannot be undertaken with an indolent mind. Alongside restraint in speech, he must strengthen himself: through diligence in faithfully putting his words into practice, he seeks daily renewal to advance his work. He must exert vigor in acting before speaking: through courage in pressing forward, he strives for timely diligence to perfect himself. Wherever the Way lies, he thinks of following it without cease, laboring tirelessly and not daring to slacken even for a single breath. All that is inherent in his nature he silently brings to fulfillment, concerned only that his efforts may be insufficient. Wherever righteousness lies, he thinks of putting it into practice whenever he perceives it, applying himself unceasingly and not daring to relax his purpose for even a single thought. All that his allotted duties require him to do he carries through to the utmost, ashamed only if his own conduct falls short. Thus the gentleman does not entirely dispense with speech; rather, his heart desires to be slow to speak. By making reticence the rule of his speech, does he not become a gentleman who speaks well? Nor does he insist rigidly upon carrying out every action; rather, his heart desires to be diligent. By making diligence the rule of his conduct, does he not become a gentleman who acts well? When speech and conduct are good, the gentleman’s learning of the heart finds its full realization in this. Yet people slight what is easy and fail to exert themselves in what is…

title: 嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
text:
德至敎固有異位而同神矣惟天無遺覆也惟
聖無遺施也大順大化不其合一而無二乎謂
之曰配天信乎聖人與昊天爲一道而盛德大
業斯其至矣非至聖其孰能與於此雖然聖人
不特配天已也覆載生成之偏天地不能無憾
而彌綸參贊之責實於聖人有賴焉觀易所謂
后以財成天地之道輔相天地之宜則聖人有
功於天亦大矣天地設位聖人成能豈曰小補
之哉然要其所以致之者一誠而已故曰誠者
===
聖人之本
乃若其情則可以爲善矣乃所謂善也
周思充
同考試官敎諭任批即情論性孟子曉人以
易見者此作能發明之諸說不攻而自破矣
同考試官敎諭楊批講可以爲善迥出諸作
考試官敎諭管批得孟子意
考試官敎諭李批明盡
大賢言已之道性善徴諸情而得之也蓋善者
punctuated:
德至敎，固有異位而同神矣。惟天無遺覆也，惟聖無遺施也，大順大化，不其合一而無二乎？謂之曰配天，信乎聖人與昊天爲一道，而盛德大業斯其至矣。非至聖，其孰能與於此？雖然，聖人不特配天已也。覆載生成之偏，天地不能無憾，而彌綸參贊之責，實於聖人有賴焉。觀《易》所謂「后以財成天地之道，輔相天地之宜」，則聖人有功於天亦大矣。天地設位，聖人成能，豈曰小補之哉？然要其所以致之者，一誠而已。故曰：「誠者，聖人之本。」

乃若其情，則可以爲善矣，乃所謂善也。

周思充

同考試官敎諭任批：即情論性，孟子曉人以易見者，此作能發明之，諸說不攻而自破矣。

同考試官敎諭楊批：講可以爲善，迥出諸作。

考試官敎諭管批：得孟子意。

考試官敎諭李批：明盡。

大賢言已之道，性善徴諸情而得之也。蓋善者
translation_en:
…virtue and consummate teaching [?]: though their positions differ, their spiritual efficacy is the same. Heaven leaves nothing uncovered; the sage leaves nothing untouched by his beneficence. Are not supreme accord and supreme transformation united as one, without distinction? This is called matching Heaven. Truly, the sage and August Heaven constitute a single Way, and here flourishing virtue and great achievement reach their utmost. Who but the consummate sage could attain this? Yet the sage does more than merely match Heaven. Heaven and Earth cannot be without shortcomings in the unevenness of their covering, supporting, generating, and completing things; they depend upon the sage to fulfill the responsibility of comprehensively ordering their workings and assisting their transforming activity. Consider what the Book of Changes says: “The ruler regulates and completes the Way of Heaven and Earth, assisting what is fitting to Heaven and Earth.” Thus the sage’s contribution to Heaven is indeed great. Heaven and Earth take their positions, and the sage brings their capacities to fulfillment: could this be called a minor supplement? Yet the essential means by which he achieves this is sincerity alone. Hence it is said: “Sincerity is the foundation of the sage.”

“As for their actual dispositions, they can become good; this is what I mean by goodness.”

Zhou Sichong

Comment by Associate Examiner Ren, Instructor: Mencius discusses human nature through its dispositions, enlightening people by means of what is readily observable. This essay elucidates that approach; the various other theories collapse of themselves without needing to be attacked.

Comment by Associate Examiner Yang, Instructor: Its explanation of “can become good” far surpasses the other essays.

Comment by Examiner Guan, Instructor: It captures Mencius’s meaning.

Comment by Examiner Li, Instructor: Clear and exhaustive.

title: 嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
text:
性之本體也徵諸情而善斯著矣論性者復何
疑乎孟子曉公都子之意若曰性之不明言之
者之不得其故也吾謂性之本善何哉蓋論性
於已漓之後則僞而失眞論性於未發之前則
隱而難見乃若以其情而觀之天機莫測而隨
感以效天下之動者皆各當於帝則之良思慮
莫及而順應以通天下之故者皆各中乎當然
之則循其端可以充其量本體流通固其幾之
不容已而非有所强也致其曲可以會其全天
===
眞呈露固其理之不容遏而非有所待也斯不
謂情之善乎夫使情之未善吾亦無徵而必謂
性之善也今既有是情則必有是性感寂相因
觀諸應物而廓然之公以昭動靜一原驗之中
節而大本之中以著性達諸天若不容易窺其
際也卽幾之不容已者而遡其貞靜之常夫固
天精天粹而無有一毫之雜矣性通諸命若不
得易究其微也卽理之不容遏者而窮其虛明
之體夫固不二不雜而不容一物之間矣此吾
punctuated: 性之本體也。徵諸情而善斯著矣，論性者復何疑乎？孟子曉公都子之意若曰：「性之不明，言之者之不得其故也。吾謂性之本善，何哉？蓋論性於已漓之後，則僞而失眞；論性於未發之前，則隱而難見。乃若以其情而觀之，天機莫測，而隨感以效天下之動者，皆各當於帝則之良；思慮莫及，而順應以通天下之故者，皆各中乎當然之則。循其端，可以充其量，本體流通，固其幾之不容已，而非有所强也；致其曲，可以會其全，天眞呈露，固其理之不容遏，而非有所待也。斯不謂情之善乎？夫使情之未善，吾亦無徵而必謂性之善也。今既有是情，則必有是性。感寂相因，觀諸應物，而廓然之公以昭；動靜一原，驗之中節，而大本之中以著。性達諸天，若不容易窺其際也；卽幾之不容已者，而遡其貞靜之常，夫固天精天粹，而無有一毫之雜矣。性通諸命，若不得易究其微也；卽理之不容遏者，而窮其虛明之體，夫固不二不雜，而不容一物之間矣。此吾
translation_en: …is the fundamental substance of human nature. Examine its affective manifestations, and its goodness becomes evident. What further doubts can those who discuss human nature have? Mencius’s intention in enlightening Gongduzi was as though he said: “Human nature remains obscure because those who speak of it fail to grasp its basis. Why do I say that human nature is originally good? If we discuss it after its purity has been diluted, it is falsified and loses its authenticity; if we discuss it before it has become manifest, it is hidden and difficult to discern. But consider it through its affective manifestations. Heaven’s workings are unfathomable, yet the movements enacted throughout the world in response to stimuli each accord with the goodness of the Supreme Lord’s standard. Thought and deliberation cannot reach them, yet responses that accord with circumstances and comprehend the affairs of the world each hit upon the proper rule. By following these beginnings, one can develop their full capacity: the fundamental substance flows freely because its incipient impulses cannot cease, not because anything compels them. By fully developing its particular manifestations, one can comprehend its entirety: its heavenly authenticity reveals itself because its principle cannot be checked, not because it awaits anything else. Is this not what we call the goodness of the affective manifestations? If those manifestations were not good, I too would have no evidence on which to insist that human nature is good. Since such manifestations exist, however, such a nature must exist. Responsiveness and stillness depend upon one another: observe responses to things, and the expansive impartiality of human nature becomes clear. Activity and tranquility share a single source: examine responses that attain due measure, and the centrality of the great foundation becomes evident. Human nature reaches through to Heaven, and its bounds may seem difficult to discern. Yet follow those incipient impulses that cannot cease back to their constant integrity and stillness: there is assuredly Heaven’s finest essence and purest substance, without the slightest admixture. Human nature communicates with Heaven’s mandate, and its subtleties may seem difficult to fathom. Yet take that principle which cannot be checked and investigate to the utmost its empty and luminous substance: it is assuredly undivided and unmixed, admitting not a single thing between. This is what I…

title: 嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
text:
之謂性善寧非因其已然之迹而徵其固有之
真也哉噫彼公都子者亦何獨於三說而疑之
抑論體用互發論性之學也動靜交養事心之
功也孟子之學得之子思乍見孺子之情於中
節之和實為真切觀之戒懼慎獨即存心養性
之事其天也性學淵源於此可見君子亦毋謂
性之必善而忘其旦晝之牿哉
易
觀其所聚而天地萬物之情可見矣
===
宋文卿
同考試官教諭張批此題作者皆援入卦辭
殊覺浮冗簡潔明暢僅見此篇錄之以魁多士
同考試官學正李批得潔靜精微之旨宜錄
為式
考試官教諭管批約而盡
考試官教諭李批明暢典雅
彖傳極言萃道而悉其所蘊之大焉夫天地萬
物皆以聚為情者也觀於此而萃道之大可識
punctuated:
之謂性善，寧非因其已然之迹而徵其固有之真也哉？噫！彼公都子者，亦何獨於三說而疑之？抑論體用互發，論性之學也；動靜交養，事心之功也。孟子之學得之子思，乍見孺子之情，於中節之和實為真切。觀之，戒懼慎獨，即存心養性之事，其天也。性學淵源，於此可見。君子亦毋謂性之必善而忘其旦晝之牿哉！

易

觀其所聚，而天地萬物之情可見矣。

宋文卿

同考試官教諭張批：此題作者皆援入卦辭，殊覺浮冗。簡潔明暢，僅見此篇，錄之以魁多士。

同考試官學正李批：得潔靜精微之旨，宜錄為式。

考試官教諭李批：明暢典雅。

彖傳極言萃道，而悉其所蘊之大焉。夫天地萬物皆以聚為情者也，觀於此而萃道之大可識
translation_en:
…what I call the goodness of human nature. Is this not to infer its inherent truth from the traces of its actual manifestations? Ah! Why, then, did Gongduzi harbor doubts specifically about those three explanations? To discuss how substance and function illuminate one another is the study of human nature; to nurture both activity and stillness is the work of tending the mind. Mengzi received his learning from Zisi. The feelings aroused on suddenly seeing a young child exemplify, with particular immediacy and clarity, the harmony of feelings expressed in due measure. Consider this: vigilance, apprehension, and watchfulness over oneself when alone are precisely the work of preserving the mind and nourishing human nature—its Heaven-given character [?]. Here we can discern the source and transmission of the learning concerning human nature. Let the gentleman not assume that human nature is necessarily good and forget the fetters imposed upon it during the day!

Book of Changes

“Observe what they gather around, and the true dispositions of Heaven, Earth, and the myriad things can be seen.”

Song Wenqing

Associate Examiner Zhang, Instructor, comments: “Those writing on this topic all draw in the hexagram statement, making their work seem decidedly superficial and verbose. This essay alone is concise, clear, and fluent. I select it to stand at the head of the candidates.”

Associate Examiner Li, School Instructor, comments: “It captures the purport of purity, stillness, subtlety, and profundity. It should be selected as a model.”

Examiner Guan, Instructor, comments: “Concise yet exhaustive.”

Examiner Li, Instructor, comments: “Clear, fluent, and classically elegant.”

The Commentary on the Judgments expounds fully the Way of Gathering and brings out all the greatness it contains. Heaven, Earth, and the myriad things all have gathering as their true disposition. By observing this, one can recognize the greatness of the Way of Gathering…

title: 嘉靖四十年浙江鄉試錄
text:
矣此彖傳所以極言之也蓋曰物理之在天下
至渙者固其散殊之迹至一者則其統會之真
萃以聚爲義卦辭固已彰其蘊矣然其道甚大
而所以體其撰者未也由是仰觀俯察凡充塞
于兩間者無弗考焉其理至賾而所以類其情
者未也由是遠求近取凡紛紜于宇宙者無弗
究焉此蓋由至約以該至博而欲達觀以悉其
變卽至一以求不一而欲推類以盡其餘其情
豈不可見乎是故法象莫大乎天地其卑高之
===
位雖判矣然下濟上行絪縕之氣自交密而無
間並育莫衆於萬物其形色之賦雖殊矣然氣
求聲應二五之精自妙合而不離兩其化也而
一實神之固造化之所以不匱也是豈强之使
合哉蓋氣機默運有以生之必有以成之雖天
地不能外是以爲情矣以羣分也而以類聚之
固品彙之所以咸亨也亦豈瀆之使聚哉蓋物
理潛孚有以倡之必有以和之雖萬物不能外
是以爲情矣吁天地萬物且然萃之道其誠大
